    {u : ℕ → ℝ} {r s B : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≠ s)
    (k : ℕ) (hstep : ∀ n < k, u (n + 1) ≤ r * u n + B * s ^ n) :
    u k ≤ r ^ k * (u 0 - B / (s - r)) + B / (s - r) * s ^ k

  Real.instLE.le 0 r →

  have hne : s - r ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hrs.symm

      _ ≤ ‖z₀‖ + ρ := by linarith

         ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹) * (∮ ζ in C(0, R), (ζ - w)⁻¹ * (0 : ℂ))) -
        ((Real.pi : ℂ)⁻¹) * (I_near + I_far) ∧
      ‖I_near‖ ≤ 4 * Real.pi * supNormOn (dbarComplex (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ))) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) * ‖z - w‖ ∧
      ‖I_far‖ ≤ (4 * Real.pi * supNormOn (dbarComplex (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ))) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) *

                And

                      (instHSub.hSub
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (Complex.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                          (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ z)) 0) 0 R))
                        (instHMul.hMul
                          (Complex.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) Complex.I))
                          (circleIntegral (fun ζ => instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (instHSub.hSub ζ w)) 0) 0 R)))
                      (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi)) (instHAdd.hAdd I_near I_far))))
                  (And
                    (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_near)
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                          (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex fun x => 0)
                            (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                        (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w))))
                    (Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm I_far)
                      (instHMul.hMul
                        (instHDiv.hDiv
                          (instHMul.hMul
                            (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 4 Real.pi)
                              (GromovCompactness.Analysis.supNormOn (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex fun x => 0)
                                (Metric.ball 0 R)))
                            (instHPow.hPow (instHAdd.hAdd R r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α)))

                        (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))))

  · simp only [norm_zero]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 1 - α := by linarith

    have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖z - w‖ ^ α := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) α
    have h_sup : 0 ≤ supNormOn (dbarComplex (fun _ : ℂ => (0 : ℂ))) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=

theorem holder_power_interpolation_on_disk
    {r α : ℝ} (_hr : 0 < r) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r)

    ‖z - w‖ ≤ (2 * r) ^ (1 - α) * ‖z - w‖ ^ α
goal_type:
∀ {r α : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
      Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
        ∀ {z w : Complex},

            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
              Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w))
                (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 r) (instHSub.hSub 1 α))

proof:
by
  by_cases hzw : z = w
  · subst hzw
    simp [Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt hα0)]
  · have hz_norm : ‖z‖ ≤ r := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
    have hw_norm : ‖w‖ ≤ r := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
    have h_pos : 0 < ‖z - w‖ := norm_sub_pos_iff.mpr hzw
    have h_le : ‖z - w‖ ≤ 2 * r := by
      have h1 : ‖z - w‖ ≤ ‖z‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_sub_le z w
      linarith
    have h1a : 0 ≤ 1 - α := by linarith
    have h_rpow : ‖z - w‖ ^ (1 - α) ≤ (2 * r) ^ (1 - α) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (le_of_lt h_pos) h_le h1a
    have h_split : ‖z - w‖ = ‖z - w‖ ^ (1 - α) * ‖z - w‖ ^ α := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add h_pos, sub_add_cancel, Real.rpow_one]
    conv_lhs => rw [h_split]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt h_pos) α)

        ∑ v : pdata.tree.V, totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) ∧
      ∃ (σ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)

Unconditional 2D quadratic-gauge subharmonic mean-value bound for `c = 0`:
for a $C^2$ function `e ≥ 0` satisfying `Δe ≥ -b e²` on `ball 0 r` and `e(w) ≤ 4 e(z₀)` on `closedBall z₀ ρ`,
modifying `e` by `K |w - z₀|² / 4` with `K = 16(b+1)e(z₀)²` yields
`π t² e(z₀) ≤ ∫_{B(z₀,t)} e + π K t⁴ / 8` for all `t ∈ (0, ρ]`.

    (z₀ : ℂ) (_he₀_pos : 0 < e z₀)

    (h_sub : Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r)
    (h_bound : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ, e w ≤ 4 * e z₀) :
    Real.pi * t^2 * e z₀ ≤

  rw [hg_center] at h_mv
  have he_int : IntegrableOn e (Metric.ball z₀ t) volume :=

  rw [setIntegral_quadratic_gauge_ball z₀ K ht.1.le he_int] at h_mv

theorem energy_density_with_J_eq_omega
    («ω» : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (h_skew : ∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I x), «ω» x v w = - «ω» x w v)
    (J : (x : M) → TangentSpace I x →L[ℝ] TangentSpace I x)
    (h_J_sq : ∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x), J x (J x v) = -v)
    (u : CP1 → M) (z : CP1)
    (h_cr : ∀ v : TangentSpace I_CP1 z, mfderiv I_CP1 I u z (J_CP1 v) = J (u z) (mfderiv I_CP1 I u z v)) :
    riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ I «ω» J u z = «ω» (u z) (mfderiv I_CP1 I u z e1) (mfderiv I_CP1 I u z e2)

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M]
  (ω :
    (x : M) →
      ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x)
        (ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) Real)),
  (∀ (x : M) (v w : TangentSpace I x),
      Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω x) v) w)
        (Real.instNeg.neg (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω x) w) v))) →
    ∀ (J : (x : M) → ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (TangentSpace I x) (TangentSpace I x)),
      (∀ (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
          Eq (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J x) v))
            (SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass.neg v)) →
        ∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          (∀ (v : TangentSpace GromovCompactness.I_CP1 z),
              Eq
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z)
                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe GromovCompactness.J_CP1 v))
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (J (u z))
                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) v))) →
            Eq (GromovCompactness.Extensions.riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ I ω J u z)
              (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (ω (u z))
                  (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) GromovCompactness.e1))
                (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (mfderiv GromovCompactness.I_CP1 I u z) GromovCompactness.e2))
proof:

  dsimp [riemannianEnergyDensityWithJ, symmetrizedMetric]
  have he1 : J_CP1 e1 = e2 := J_CP1_e1
  have he2 : J_CP1 e2 = -e1 := J_CP1_e2
  have hcr1 := h_cr e1
  have hcr2 := h_cr e2
  rw [he1] at hcr1
  rw [he2] at hcr2
  have hmap_neg : mfderiv I_CP1 I u z (-e1) = - mfderiv I_CP1 I u z e1 :=
    (mfderiv I_CP1 I u z).map_neg e1
  rw [hmap_neg] at hcr2
  let v1 := mfderiv I_CP1 I u z e1
  let v2 := mfderiv I_CP1 I u z e2
  have hv2 : v2 = J (u z) v1 := hcr1
  have hv1_neg : -v1 = J (u z) v2 := by
    rw [hv2, h_J_sq (u z) v1]
  have hJv2 : J (u z) v2 = -v1 := hv1_neg.symm
  rw [← hv2]
  have h_term2 : «ω» (u z) v2 (J (u z) v2) = «ω» (u z) v2 (-v1) := by rw [hJv2]
  have h_neg_v1 : «ω» (u z) v2 (-v1) = - «ω» (u z) v2 v1 := («ω» (u z) v2).map_neg v1
  have h_skew_val : - «ω» (u z) v2 v1 = «ω» (u z) v1 v2 := by
    rw [h_skew (u z) v2 v1]
    ring
  rw [h_term2, h_neg_v1, h_skew_val]
  have h_step : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * («ω» (u z) v1 v2 + «ω» (u z) v1 v2) +
                             (1 / 2 : ℝ) * («ω» (u z) v1 v2 + «ω» (u z) v1 v2)) =
                «ω» (u z) v1 v2 := by ring
  exact h_step

signature:
theorem assemble_global_frames
    (tree : SphereTree) (root : tree.V)
    (res : TreeRescalingData tree root) :
    ∃ (frames : (v : tree.V) → ℕ → MoebiusFrame),
      (∀ n, frames root n = MoebiusFrame.id) ∧
      (∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : w ≠ root) (n : ℕ),
        frames w n = MoebiusFrame.comp (frames (res.parent w hw) n)
          (affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) (res.scale_pos w n))) ∧
      (∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w),
        ∀ K ⊆ punctured_sphere {tree.node_point w v (tree.adj.adj_symm h)}, IsCompact K →
          TendstoUniformlyOn
            (fun n => (MoebiusFrame.comp (MoebiusFrame.inv (frames v n)) (frames w n)).toHomeo)
            (fun _ => tree.node_point v w h) atTop K)

    And (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id)
      (And
        (∀ (w : tree.V) (hw : Ne w root) (n : Nat),
          Eq (frames w n)
            ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯)))
        (∀ (v w : tree.V) (h : tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Set.instLE.le K
              (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
            IsCompact K →
              TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                (fun x => tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K))

  refine ⟨globalFrameAt tree root res, globalFrameAt_root tree root res,
    globalFrameAt_ne_root tree root res, ?_⟩
  intro v w h K hK_sub hK_comp

        MoebiusFrame.comp (globalFrameAt tree root res (res.parent w hw) n)
          (affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) (res.scale_pos w n)) :=
      globalFrameAt_ne_root tree root res w hw
    simp_rw [h_step]
    exact transition_collapse_reduction
      (globalFrameAt tree root res (res.parent w hw))
      (fun n => affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) (res.scale_pos w n))

      globalFrameAt_ne_root tree root res v hv

    exact transition_collapse_reduction_inv
      (globalFrameAt tree root res (res.parent v hv))
      (fun n => affine_scaling (res.center v n) (res.scale v n) (res.scale_pos v n))

    (h_nested : ∀ k, IsSubsequenceOf (σ_family (k + 1)) (σ_family k)) :

  (∀ (k : Nat), GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.IsSubsequenceOf (σ_family (instHAdd.hAdd k 1)) (σ_family k)) →

    isSubsequenceOf_add σ_family h_nested k d
  rcases h_sub with ⟨τ, hτ⟩
  use τ.1 (k + d)
  dsimp [σ_diag, diag_fun]
  rw [hτ]
  rfl

docstring: In any one-level decomposition, every child defect mass is bounded by m - h (Contract B06).
signature:
theorem child_mass_le_parent_sub_h
    (thresh : TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)
    (decomp : OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)
    (hm : thresh.h ≤ m_defect) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ decomp.q) :
    decomp.m_child z ≤ m_defect - thresh.h
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real) (base_val : M)
  (decomp : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val),
  Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect →
    ∀ (z : Complex),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem decomp.q z → Real.instLE.le (decomp.m_child z) (instHSub.hSub m_defect thresh.h)
proof:
by
  have h_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ decomp.q, 0 ≤ decomp.m_child x := fun x hx =>
    (thresh.h_pos.trans_le (decomp.m_child_pos x hx)).le
  by_cases h_const : ∃ c : M, ∀ w, decomp.v w = c
  · have h_card := ghost_component_branches_of_const I thresh m_defect base_val decomp hm h_const
    have h_ex_ne : ∃ w ∈ decomp.q, w ≠ z := by
      by_contra h_all
      push_neg at h_all
      have h_sub : decomp.q ⊆ {z} := fun w hw => Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (h_all w hw)
      have h_card_le : decomp.q.card ≤ 1 := (Finset.card_le_card h_sub).trans_eq (Finset.card_singleton z)
      omega
    rcases h_ex_ne with ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩
    have hw_mem_erase : w ∈ decomp.q.erase z := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hwz, hw⟩
    have h_decomp_erase : decomp.q = insert z (decomp.q.erase z) := (Finset.insert_erase hz).symm
    have hz_not_erase : z ∉ decomp.q.erase z := Finset.notMem_erase z decomp.q
    have h_sum_split : (∑ x ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child x) =
        decomp.m_child z + ∑ x ∈ decomp.q.erase z, decomp.m_child x := by
      nth_rw 1 [h_decomp_erase]
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hz_not_erase]
    have h_w_le_sum : decomp.m_child w ≤ ∑ x ∈ decomp.q.erase z, decomp.m_child x :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun x hx => h_nonneg x (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx)) hw_mem_erase
    have h_h_le_w : thresh.h ≤ decomp.m_child w := decomp.m_child_pos w hw
    have h_h_le_erase : thresh.h ≤ ∑ x ∈ decomp.q.erase z, decomp.m_child x :=
      h_h_le_w.trans h_w_le_sum
    have h_sum_le_m : (∑ x ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child x) ≤ m_defect :=
      OneLevelDecomposition.child_mass_sum_le I thresh m_defect base_val decomp
    linarith [h_sum_split, h_h_le_erase, h_sum_le_m]
  · have h_en_sph : thresh.ε_sph ≤ totalEnergy I decomp.v :=
      thresh.h_sph decomp.v decomp.v_jhol h_const
    have h_h_le_en : thresh.h ≤ totalEnergy I decomp.v := thresh.h_le_sph.trans h_en_sph
    have h_z_le_sum : decomp.m_child z ≤ ∑ x ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child x :=
      Finset.single_le_sum h_nonneg hz
    have h_ms := decomp.mass_sum
    linarith [h_h_le_en, h_z_le_sum, h_ms]

name: volume_map_affine
docstring:
Affine transformation of Lebesgue volume on ℂ:
For w ↦ a + l • w, the pushforward measure scales by (l⁻¹)^2.
signature:
theorem volume_map_affine (a : ℂ) (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) :
    Measure.map (fun w => a + l • w) (volume : Measure ℂ) =
    ENNReal.ofReal (l⁻¹ ^ 2) • volume
goal_type:
∀ (a : Complex) (l : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 l →
    Eq
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun w => instHAdd.hAdd a (instHSMul.hSMul l w))
        measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume)
      (instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (instHPow.hPow (Real.instInv.inv l) 2)) measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume)
proof:
by
  have heq : (fun w => a + l • w) = (fun w => w + a) ∘ (fun w => l • w) := by
    ext w
    dsimp
    rw [add_comm]
  rw [heq]
  have h_meas_smul : Measurable (fun (w : ℂ) => l • w) :=
    continuous_const_smul l |>.measurable
  have h_meas_trans : Measurable (fun (w : ℂ) => w + a) :=
    (continuous_id.add continuous_const : Continuous fun w : ℂ => w + a) |>.measurable
  rw [← Measure.map_map h_meas_trans h_meas_smul]
  rw [volume_map_homothety l hl]
  rw [Measure.map_smul]
  rw [volume_map_translation a]
  exact h_meas_trans.aemeasurable

    (h_prin_fin : is_principal_component I lim v → Finite { ϕ : MoebiusFrame // ∀ z, lim.map v (ϕ.toHomeo z) = lim.map v z }) :

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (v : lim.tree.V),
  (GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v →
      Finite (Subtype fun ϕ => Eq ϕ.toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem))) →
    (GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I lim v →
        Finite
          (Subtype fun ϕ =>
            ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (lim.map v (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ.toHomeo z)) (lim.map v z))) →

      fun ⟨ϕ, h_cond⟩ => ⟨ϕ, h_cond.1 hg⟩
    have hf_inj : Function.Injective f := by
      intro ⟨ϕ₁, h₁⟩ ⟨ϕ₂, h₂⟩ h_eq

      (fun n => (u_seq (pdata.σ.1 n)) ∘ (pdata.frames root'.1 n).toHomeo)

      (∃ ϕ_root : ℕ → MoebiusFrame, ∀ n, frames' root' n = ϕ_root n) ∧
      (∀ (v w : { v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root })

        ∀ K ⊆ punctured_sphere {pdata.tree.node_point w.1 v.1 (pdata.tree.adj.adj_symm h)}, IsCompact K →

          (pdata.map v.1)
          (punctured_sphere { z | ∃ (w : { v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root })

      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames root'.val n).toHomeo))
          (pdata.map root'.val)

name: sphere_energy_gap_of_stokes_and_diameter
docstring:
Conditional Reduction theorem: Epsilon-regularity / diameter bound and Stokes exactness together
imply the minimal energy gap.
Note (Conditional Reduction per COMPLETION_PLAN.md §0 & §2 P0-9):
Takes open analytical contract hypotheses (`h_diam`, `h_stokes`) and does not count as closing
Contract A07 unconditionally.
signature:
theorem sphere_energy_gap_of_stokes_and_diameter
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
    {M : Type*} [MetricSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    [IsManifold I ∞ M] [CompactSpace M] [ClosedTameTarget I M]
    (ε_diam : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε_diam) (r_inj : ℝ) (_hr_inj : 0 < r_inj)
    (h_diam : ∀ (u : CP1 → M),
      JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) u Set.univ →
      totalEnergy I u < ε_diam →
      Metric.diam (Set.range u) < r_inj)
    (h_stokes : ∀ (u : CP1 → M),
      JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) u Set.univ →
      Metric.diam (Set.range u) < r_inj →
      totalEnergy I u = 0)
    (h_const_of_zero : ∀ (u : CP1 → M),
      JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) u Set.univ →
      totalEnergy I u = 0 →
      ∃ c : M, ∀ z, u z = c) :
    ∃ (ε_sph : ℝ), 0 < ε_sph ∧
    ∀ (u : CP1 → M),
      JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) u Set.univ →
      (¬ ∃ c : M, ∀ z, u z = c) →
      ε_sph ≤ totalEnergy I u
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (ε_diam : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_diam →
    ∀ (r_inj : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 r_inj →
        (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
            GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
              Real.instLT.lt (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) ε_diam →
                Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) r_inj) →
          (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.range u)) r_inj → Eq (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) 0) →
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                  Eq (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u) 0 →
                    Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
              Exists fun ε_sph =>
                And (Real.instLT.lt 0 ε_sph)
                  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
                    GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
                      Not (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u z) c) →
                        Real.instLE.le ε_sph (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I u))

by
  refine ⟨ε_diam, hε, ?_⟩
  intro u hu h_nonconst
  by_contra h_lt
  push_neg at h_lt
  have hdiam := h_diam u hu h_lt
  have hzero := h_stokes u hu hdiam
  have hconst := h_const_of_zero u hu hzero
  exact h_nonconst hconst

name: dirac_sum_isolating_set
docstring: Evaluating a finite sum of weighted Dirac measures on a measurable set A that isolates p ∈ S yields m(p) (Kernel-verified).
signature:
lemma dirac_sum_isolating_set (S : Finset CP1) (m : CP1 → ℝ) (A : Set CP1) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    (p : CP1) (hp : p ∈ S) (h_isol : A ∩ (S : Set CP1) = {p}) :
    (∑ x ∈ S, (ENNReal.ofReal (m x) • Measure.dirac x)) A = ENNReal.ofReal (m p)
goal_type:
∀ (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem) (m : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real) (A : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
  MeasurableSet A →
    ∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem S p →
        Eq (Set.instInter.inter A (Finset.instSetLike.coe S)) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
          Eq
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe
              (S.sum fun x => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m x)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x)) A)
            (ENNReal.ofReal (m p))
proof:
by
  rw [Measure.finset_sum_apply]
  have h_split : S = insert p (S.erase p) := (Finset.insert_erase hp).symm
  rw [h_split, Finset.sum_insert (Finset.notMem_erase p S)]
  have hp_in_A : p ∈ A := by
    have hp_mem : p ∈ ({p} : Set CP1) := Set.mem_singleton p
    rw [← h_isol] at hp_mem
    exact hp_mem.1
  have h_dirac_self : (ENNReal.ofReal (m p) • Measure.dirac p) A = ENNReal.ofReal (m p) := by
    rw [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.dirac_apply_of_mem hp_in_A, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have h_dirac_rest : ∑ x ∈ S.erase p, (ENNReal.ofReal (m x) • Measure.dirac x) A = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    have hne : x ≠ p := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx
    have hx_S : x ∈ (S : Set CP1) := Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx)
    have hx_not_A : x ∉ A := by
      intro hx_A
      have hx_inter : x ∈ A ∩ (S : Set CP1) := ⟨hx_A, hx_S⟩
      rw [h_isol, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx_inter
      exact hne hx_inter
    rw [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.dirac_apply' x hA, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx_not_A, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
  rw [h_dirac_self, h_dirac_rest, add_zero]

lemma heinz_central_value_bound_c_zero (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (e₀ : ℝ) (he₀ : 0 < e₀) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (E : ℝ) (_hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (h_smv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ρ, e₀ ≤ (Real.pi * t^2)⁻¹ * E + 2 * b * e₀^2 * t^2)
    (h_energy : E < Real.pi / (16 * (b + 1))) :
    (2 * ρ)^2 * e₀ ≤ (8 / Real.pi) * E

  Real.instLE.le 0 b →
    ∀ (e₀ : Real),
      Real.instLT.lt 0 e₀ →
        ∀ (ρ : Real),
          Real.instLT.lt 0 ρ →
            ∀ (E : Real),
              Real.instLE.le 0 E →
                (∀ (t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ioc 0 ρ) t →
                      Real.instLE.le e₀
                        (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul (Real.instInv.inv (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2))) E)
                          (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 b) (instHPow.hPow e₀ 2))
                            (instHPow.hPow t 2)))) →
                  Real.instLT.lt E (instHDiv.hDiv Real.pi (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd b 1))) →
                    Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHMul.hMul 2 ρ) 2) e₀)
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHDiv.hDiv 8 Real.pi) E)

  have hpi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  by_cases h_case : 2 * b * e₀ * ρ^2 ≤ 1 / 2
  · have hρ_mem : ρ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ρ := ⟨hρ, le_refl ρ⟩
    have h_bound := h_smv ρ hρ_mem
    have h_term2 : 2 * b * e₀^2 * ρ^2 = (2 * b * e₀ * ρ^2) * e₀ := by ring
    rw [h_term2] at h_bound
    have h_le_half : (2 * b * e₀ * ρ^2) * e₀ ≤ (1 / 2) * e₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_case he₀.le
    have h_half_bound : e₀ ≤ (Real.pi * ρ^2)⁻¹ * E + (1 / 2) * e₀ := le_trans h_bound (by linarith)
    have h_sub : (1 / 2) * e₀ ≤ (Real.pi * ρ^2)⁻¹ * E := by linarith
    have h_ρ2_pos : 0 < ρ^2 := sq_pos_of_pos hρ
    calc (2 * ρ)^2 * e₀ = 4 * ρ^2 * e₀ := by ring
         _ = 8 * ρ^2 * ((1 / 2) * e₀) := by ring
         _ ≤ 8 * ρ^2 * ((Real.pi * ρ^2)⁻¹ * E) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sub (by positivity)
         _ = 8 * ρ^2 * (Real.pi⁻¹ * (ρ^2)⁻¹ * E) := by rw [mul_inv]
         _ = (8 / Real.pi) * E := by
           have h_cancel : ρ^2 * (ρ^2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ h_ρ2_pos.ne'
           calc 8 * ρ^2 * (Real.pi⁻¹ * (ρ^2)⁻¹ * E) = (8 * Real.pi⁻¹ * E) * (ρ^2 * (ρ^2)⁻¹) := by ring
                _ = (8 * Real.pi⁻¹ * E) * 1 := by rw [h_cancel]
                _ = (8 / Real.pi) * E := by ring

    have hb_pos : 0 < b := by
      by_contra hb_zero
      have : b = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hb_zero) hb
      subst this
      linarith
    have h_denom_pos : 0 < 4 * b * e₀ := by positivity

      Set.indicator_of_notMem hx_not_front, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
  rw [h_bg_zero, h_atoms_zero, add_zero]

    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hΦ : 0 ≤ Φ R)
    (hcontract : A * θ ^ p < θ ^ q)
    (hstep : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) R,
      Φ (θ * r) ≤ A * θ ^ p * Φ r + B * r ^ q) (k : ℕ) :

          Real.instLE.le 0 B →
            Real.instLE.le 0 (Φ R) →
              Real.instLT.lt (instHMul.hMul A (instHPow.hPow θ p)) (instHPow.hPow θ q) →
                (∀ (r : Real),

                          (instHMul.hMul B (instHPow.hPow r q)))) →

                    Real.instLE.le (Φ (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow θ k) R))
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHPow.hPow θ q) k)

  have hrec : ∀ n < k,

    intro n _
    have hnpos : 0 < θ ^ n * R := mul_pos (pow_pos hθ n) hR
    have hnle : θ ^ n * R ≤ R := by
      have hp : θ ^ n ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hθ.le hθ1
      nlinarith
    have h := hstep (θ ^ n * R) ⟨hnpos, hnle⟩
    have hp : (θ ^ n * R) ^ q = (θ ^ q) ^ n * R ^ q := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (pow_nonneg hθ.le n) hR.le, ← Real.rpow_pow_comm hθ.le]
    rw [hp] at h

name: cp1_coord_two_bounds
docstring: The third coordinate of any point on the unit sphere satisfies $-1 \le z_2 \le 1$.
signature: theorem cp1_coord_two_bounds (z : CP1) : -1 ≤ z.1 2 ∧ z.1 2 ≤ 1
goal_type: ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), And (Real.instLE.le (-1) (z.val.ofLp 2)) (Real.instLE.le (z.val.ofLp 2) 1)
proof:
by
  have hz : ‖z.1‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp z.2
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq] at hz
  have h_pos : 0 ≤ ‖z.1 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖z.1 1‖ ^ 2 + ‖z.1 2‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h_sq := congr_arg (fun x => x^2) hz
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h_sq
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt h_pos] at h_sq
  have h_norm_sq (x : ℝ) : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := by simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  rw [h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq, h_norm_sq] at h_sq
  norm_num at h_sq
  have h_le : (z.1 2)^2 ≤ 1 := by
    have : 0 ≤ (z.1 0)^2 := sq_nonneg _
    have : 0 ≤ (z.1 1)^2 := sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  have h_abs : |z.1 2| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one]
    linarith
  exact abs_le.mp h_abs

    {α K₁ K₂ : ℝ} {f₁ f₂ : ℂ → ℂ} {s : Set ℂ}
    (hK₁ : 0 ≤ K₁) (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (h₁ : ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, ‖f₁ z - f₁ w‖ ≤ K₁ * ‖z - w‖ ^ α)
    (h₂ : ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, ‖f₂ z - f₂ w‖ ≤ K₂ * ‖z - w‖ ^ α) :
    holderSeminorm α (fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) s ≤ K₁ + K₂

          Set.instMembership.mem s z →
            ∀ (w : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f₁ z) (f₁ w)))
                  (instHMul.hMul K₁ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
        (∀ (z : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem s z →
              ∀ (w : Complex),
                Set.instMembership.mem s w →
                  Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub (f₂ z) (f₂ w)))
                    (instHMul.hMul K₂ (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α))) →
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.holderSeminorm α (fun z => instHSub.hSub (f₁ z) (f₂ z)) s)
            (instHAdd.hAdd K₁ K₂)
proof:
by
  have hK : 0 ≤ K₁ + K₂ := add_nonneg hK₁ hK₂
  have h_est :
      ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s,
        ‖(f₁ z - f₂ z) - (f₁ w - f₂ w)‖ ≤ (K₁ + K₂) * ‖z - w‖ ^ α := by
    intro z hz w hw
    have hrew :
        (f₁ z - f₂ z) - (f₁ w - f₂ w) = (f₁ z - f₁ w) - (f₂ z - f₂ w) := by
      ring
    have hnorm :
        ‖(f₁ z - f₂ z) - (f₁ w - f₂ w)‖ ≤
          ‖f₁ z - f₁ w‖ + ‖f₂ z - f₂ w‖ := by
      rw [hrew]
      exact norm_sub_le (f₁ z - f₁ w) (f₂ z - f₂ w)
    have h1 := h₁ z hz w hw
    have h2 := h₂ z hz w hw
    calc
      ‖(f₁ z - f₂ z) - (f₁ w - f₂ w)‖
          ≤ ‖f₁ z - f₁ w‖ + ‖f₂ z - f₂ w‖ := hnorm
      _ ≤ K₁ * ‖z - w‖ ^ α + K₂ * ‖z - w‖ ^ α := add_le_add h1 h2
      _ = (K₁ + K₂) * ‖z - w‖ ^ α := by ring
  exact holderSeminorm_le_of_bound (α := α) (K := K₁ + K₂)
    (f := fun z => f₁ z - f₂ z) (s := s) hK h_est

signature:
theorem moebiusFrame_comp_right_cancel (ϕ A B : MoebiusFrame)
    (h : MoebiusFrame.comp ϕ A = MoebiusFrame.comp ϕ B) : A = B
goal_type: ∀ (ϕ A B : GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame), Eq (ϕ.comp A) (ϕ.comp B) → Eq A B
proof:
by
  have h_mat : (MoebiusFrame.comp ϕ A).matrix = (MoebiusFrame.comp ϕ B).matrix := by rw [h]
  have h_homeo : (MoebiusFrame.comp ϕ A).toHomeo = (MoebiusFrame.comp ϕ B).toHomeo := by rw [h]
  dsimp [MoebiusFrame.comp] at h_mat h_homeo
  have h_mat_eq : A.matrix = B.matrix := moebiusMatrix_mul_left_cancel ϕ.matrix A.matrix B.matrix h_mat
  have h_homeo_eq : A.toHomeo = B.toHomeo := by
    apply Homeomorph.ext
    intro x
    have h_app := congr_arg (fun (H : CP1 ≃ₜ CP1) => H x) h_homeo
    dsimp [Homeomorph.trans] at h_app
    exact ϕ.toHomeo.injective h_app
  exact MoebiusFrame.ext h_mat_eq h_homeo_eq

  rw [Measure.map_apply stereo_chart_symm_measurable MeasurableSet.univ]
  simp only [Set.preimage_univ]
  rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ]

    intro w

    have h2 := sphericalJacobian_nonneg w

    lintegral_mono (μ := volume) h_bound

    · push_neg at hC0
      rw [max_eq_right hC0.le]
      have hneg : C * sphericalJacobian w ≤ 0 := by

lemma dense_compl_singleton_of_connected {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T1Space X] [ConnectedSpace X] [Nontrivial X] (p : X) :
    Dense ({p}ᶜ : Set X)
goal_type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [T1Space X] [ConnectedSpace X] [Nontrivial X] (p : X),
  Dense (Set.instCompl.compl (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p))
proof:
by
  rw [dense_iff_closure_eq, closure_compl]
  have h_int : interior ({p} : Set X) = ∅ := by
    by_contra h_ne
    have h_nonempty : (interior ({p} : Set X) : Set X).Nonempty := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr h_ne
    have h_sub : interior ({p} : Set X) ⊆ {p} := interior_subset
    have h_eq : interior ({p} : Set X) = {p} := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h_nonempty
      have hxp : x = p := mem_singleton_iff.mp (h_sub hx)
      ext y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        exact mem_singleton_iff.mp (h_sub hy) ▸ rfl
      · rintro rfl
        rwa [hxp] at hx
    have h_open : IsOpen ({p} : Set X) := by
      rw [← h_eq]
      exact isOpen_interior
    have h_clopen : IsClopen ({p} : Set X) := ⟨isClosed_singleton, h_open⟩
    cases isClopen_iff.mp h_clopen with
    | inl h0 =>
      exact (singleton_nonempty p).ne_empty h0
    | inr h_univ =>
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_ne p
      have hq_in : q ∈ ({p} : Set X) := by rw [h_univ]; trivial
      exact hq (mem_singleton_iff.mp hq_in)
  rw [h_int, compl_empty]

lemma polar_laplacian_identity (g : ℂ → ℝ) (z₀ : ℂ) (ρ θ : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ g (z₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))) (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))) +
      ρ * (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g (z₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))))
        ![Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)), Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))]) +
    (-fderiv ℝ g (z₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))) (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))) +
      ρ * (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g (z₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))))
        ![Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)), Complex.I * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))]) =
    ρ * laplacian2D g (z₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))

  Eq
    (instHAdd.hAdd
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
          (fderiv Real g
            (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
              (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
          (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
        (instHMul.hMul ρ
          (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
            (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 g
              (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
            (Matrix.vecCons (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))
              (Matrix.vecCons (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))) Matrix.vecEmpty)))))
      (instHAdd.hAdd
        (Real.instNeg.neg
          (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe
            (fderiv Real g
              (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
            (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))
        (instHMul.hMul ρ
          (ContinuousMultilinearMap.funLike.coe
            (iteratedFDeriv Real 2 g
              (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
                (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))))
            (Matrix.vecCons (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
              (Matrix.vecCons (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ))))
                Matrix.vecEmpty))))))
    (instHMul.hMul ρ
      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D g
        (instHAdd.hAdd z₀
          (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal ρ) (Complex.exp (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (Complex.ofReal θ)))))))
proof:
by
  let ζ := z₀ + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))
  let eθ := Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))
  have h_rot := cmlm2_rotation_trace_scaling (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g ζ) eθ
  have h_norm : ‖eθ‖ = 1 := by
    dsimp [eθ]
    rw [mul_comm Complex.I (θ : ℂ)]
    exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I θ
  rw [h_norm, one_pow, one_mul] at h_rot
  unfold laplacian2D
  change (fderiv ℝ g ζ eθ + ρ * (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g ζ) ![eθ, eθ]) +
    (-fderiv ℝ g ζ eθ + ρ * (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g ζ) ![Complex.I * eθ, Complex.I * eθ]) =
    ρ * ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g ζ) ![1, 1] + (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 g ζ) ![Complex.I, Complex.I])
  rw [← h_rot]
  ring

          And (MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν)

docstring:
Strict Energy Rank Decrease arithmetic lemma (Contract B06).
If h > 0 and 0 ≤ m_i ≤ m - h, then ⌊m_i / h⌋ < ⌊m / h⌋.
signature:
theorem energy_rank_strict_decrease (m m_i h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (h_pos : 0 ≤ m_i) (hle : m_i ≤ m - h) :
    Nat.floor (m_i / h) < Nat.floor (m / h)

  Real.instLT.lt 0 h →
    Real.instLE.le 0 m_i →
      Real.instLE.le m_i (instHSub.hSub m h) →
        instLTNat.lt (Nat.floor (instHDiv.hDiv m_i h)) (Nat.floor (instHDiv.hDiv m h))
proof:

  have h_div : m_i / h ≤ m / h - 1 := by
    calc
      m_i / h ≤ (m - h) / h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hle hh.le
      _ = m / h - h / h := sub_div m h h
      _ = m / h - 1 := by rw [div_self hh.ne']
  have h_floor_le := Nat.floor_mono h_div
  have h1 : 0 ≤ m / h - 1 := by
    calc
      0 ≤ m_i / h := div_nonneg h_pos hh.le

          have := Nat.floor_le h1
          linarith

    have h_le_floor : Nat.floor (m / h - 1) + 1 ≤ Nat.floor (m / h) :=
      Nat.le_floor h_lt
    exact Nat.lt_of_succ_le h_le_floor
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_floor_le h_floor_sub

name: dil_homeo_ne_id
docstring: Dilation homeomorphism is strictly non-identity when $\lambda \ne 1$.
signature:
theorem dil_homeo_ne_id (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (hne : l ≠ 1) :
    dil_homeo l hl ≠ Homeomorph.refl CP1
goal_type:
∀ (l : Real) (hl : Real.instLT.lt 0 l),
  Ne l 1 → Ne (GromovCompactness.dil_homeo l hl) (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
proof:
by
  intro h
  let p : CP1 := ⟨!₂[1, 0, 0], by
    simp only [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]⟩
  have hp : dil_homeo l hl p = Homeomorph.refl CP1 p := by rw [h]
  have h_coord : (dil_homeo l hl p).1 2 = (Homeomorph.refl CP1 p).1 2 := by rw [hp]
  change (dil_fun l p.1) 2 = p.1 2 at h_coord
  rw [dil_fun_2] at h_coord
  have hp2 : p.1 2 = 0 := rfl
  rw [hp2] at h_coord
  dsimp [D_val] at h_coord
  have h_simp : (1 - l^2 + (1 + l^2) * 0) / (1 + l^2 + (1 - l^2) * 0) = (1 - l^2) / (1 + l^2) := by ring
  rw [h_simp] at h_coord
  have h_pos : 0 < 1 + l^2 := by positivity
  have h_zero : 1 - l^2 = 0 := div_eq_zero_iff.mp h_coord |>.resolve_right (ne_of_gt h_pos)
  have hl_sq : l^2 = 1 := by linarith
  have hl_one : l = 1 := by nlinarith
  exact hne hl_one

theorem subharmonic_quadratic_mean_value_bound_of_laplacian_lb_sixteen
    (r b c : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c)

    (he_cont : ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
    (he_diff : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 e (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r))
    (z₀ : ℂ) (_he₀_pos : 0 < e z₀)
    (ρ : ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioc 0 ρ)
    (h_sub : Metric.closedBall z₀ ρ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r)
    (h_lb : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ t, -16 * (b + c + 1) * (e z₀)^2 ≤ laplacian2D e w) :
    Real.pi * t^2 * e z₀ ≤

      Real.pi * (16 * (b + c + 1) * (e z₀)^2) * t^4 / 8

                                  (instHPow.hPow (e z₀) 2))
                                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D e w)) →
                          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul Real.pi (instHPow.hPow t 2)) (e z₀))
                            (instHAdd.hAdd
                              (MeasureTheory.integral
                                (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z₀ t)) fun w => e w)
                              (instHDiv.hDiv
                                (instHMul.hMul

                                    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 16 (instHAdd.hAdd (instHAdd.hAdd b c) 1))

    intro w hw

signature:
theorem dil_fun_inv_apply_1 (l : ℝ) (hl : l ≠ 0) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (hD : D_val l (v 2) ≠ 0) :
    (dil_fun l⁻¹ (dil_fun l v)) 1 = v 1
goal_type:
∀ (l : Real),
  Ne l 0 →
    ∀ (v : EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 3)),
      Ne (GromovCompactness.D_val l (v.ofLp 2)) 0 →
        Eq ((GromovCompactness.dil_fun (Real.instInv.inv l) (GromovCompactness.dil_fun l v)).ofLp 1) (v.ofLp 1)
proof:
by
  rw [dil_fun_1, dil_fun_1, dil_fun_2]
  have h_denom := dil_denom_mul l hl (v 2) hD
  have h_denom' : D_val l⁻¹ (((1 - l^2) + (1 + l^2) * v 2) / D_val l (v 2)) = 4 / D_val l (v 2) := by
    rw [← h_denom]
    exact (mul_div_cancel_left₀ (D_val l⁻¹ (((1 - l^2) + (1 + l^2) * v 2) / D_val l (v 2))) hD).symm
  rw [h_denom']
  have h_ll : l⁻¹ * l = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hl
  have : 2 * l⁻¹ * (2 * l * v 1 / D_val l (v 2)) = (4 * v 1) / D_val l (v 2) := by
    calc 2 * l⁻¹ * (2 * l * v 1 / D_val l (v 2))
      _ = (4 * (l⁻¹ * l) * v 1) / D_val l (v 2) := by ring
      _ = (4 * 1 * v 1) / D_val l (v 2) := by rw [h_ll]
      _ = (4 * v 1) / D_val l (v 2) := by ring
  rw [this]
  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  rw [div_div_div_comm, div_self hD, div_one]
  exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ (v 1) h4

      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,

signature:
lemma stabilize_prestable_tree_aux
    (u_seq : ℕ → (CP1 → M))
    (h_prune : ∀ (pdata : PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
      pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root = 1 →
      (∃ c : M, ∀ z, pdata.map pdata.root z = c) →
      ∃ (pdata' : PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
        Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V + 1 = Fintype.card pdata.tree.V ∧
        (∑ v : pdata'.tree.V, totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v)) =
          (∑ v : pdata.tree.V, totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
    (h_not_tendsto : ∀ (σ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
      ¬ Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n))) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (pdata : PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
      Fintype.card pdata.tree.V ≤ k →
      ∃ (u_lim : StableSphereTreeLimit I (M := M)),
        (∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) =
          ∑ v : pdata.tree.V, totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)) ∧
        ∃ (σ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
          (frames : (v : u_lim.tree.V) → ℕ → MoebiusFrame),
          (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
            SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
              (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)) ∘ (frames v n).toHomeo)
              (u_lim.map v)
              (punctured_sphere { z | ∃ (w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = u_lim.tree.node_point v w h })) ∧
          (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w),
            ∀ K ⊆ punctured_sphere {u_lim.tree.node_point w v (u_lim.tree.adj.adj_symm h)}, IsCompact K →
              TendstoUniformlyOn
                (fun n => (MoebiusFrame.comp (MoebiusFrame.inv (frames v n)) (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                (fun _ => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) atTop K) ∧
          Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n))) atTop
            (𝓝 (∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)))
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
      Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
        (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
          Exists fun pdata' =>
            And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))) →
    (∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        Not (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))) →
      ∀ (k : Nat) (pdata : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
        instLENat.le (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V) k →
          Exists fun u_lim =>
            And
              (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))
                (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))
              (Exists fun σ =>
                Exists fun frames =>
                  And
                    (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V),
                      GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                        (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                        (u_lim.map v)
                        (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                          (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (u_lim.tree.node_point v w h))))
                    (And
                      (∀ (v w : u_lim.tree.V) (h : u_lim.tree.adj.Adj v w) (K : Set GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                        Set.instLE.le K
                            (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                              (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (u_lim.tree.node_point w v ⋯))) →
                          IsCompact K →
                            TendstoUniformlyOn
                              (fun n => EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ((frames v n).inv.comp (frames w n)).toHomeo)
                              (fun x => u_lim.tree.node_point v w h) Filter.atTop K)
                      (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                        (nhds (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v))))))

  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro pdata h_card

    intro pdata h_card

      by_cases h_deg3 : 3 ≤ pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root
      · exact stabilize_prestable_tree_of_stable_root I u_seq pdata (fun _ => h_deg3)

         ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹) * (∮ ζ in C(0, R), (ζ - w)⁻¹ * f ζ)) -

      ‖I_far‖ ≤ (4 * Real.pi * supNormOn (dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) *

docstring:
**Universal Component Count Bounds (Contract G04 & Theorem 1)**.
For any stable sphere tree limit of total energy $\le B$:
1. $P \cdot h \le B$, so $P \le \lfloor B / h \rfloor$.
2. If $|V| > 1$, then $G \le P - 2$ and $|V| \le 2P - 2$.
3. Universally across all configurations (including single curves $|V| = 1$), the safe integer bound
   $$(|V| : \mathbb{Z}) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B / h \rfloor - 2)$$
   holds without natural subtraction truncation artifacts.

  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);
    have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I u_lim v);
    And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
      (And

          And (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd G 2) P)
            (instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) (instHMul.hMul 2 P)))
        (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast

  · intro h_multi

    constructor
    · omega
    · omega
  · by_cases h_multi : 1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V
    · have h_bound := ghost_components_bound I u_lim P G h_multi rfl rfl

    (hfg : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f k y) Filter.atTop (nhds (g y)))

    · intro _

        exact h_card.trans P.root_degree_ge

Dyadic decay from Widman hole-filling (`0 unproved`, ported from `qinz1yang/differential-geometry`):
For any antitone sequence `e : ℕ → ℝ` with `e 0 ≤ Λ` satisfying `e (j + 1) ≤ K * (e j - e (j + 1))`
whenever `e j - e (j + 1) < ε₀`, there exists `N` depending only on `(ε₀, K, Λ)` such that
`e (N + k) ≤ (K / (1 + K)) ^ k * ε₀`.
signature:
theorem dyadic_decay_of_hole_filling {ε₀ K Λ : ℝ} (hε₀ : 0 < ε₀) (hK : 0 < K)
    (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ, Antitone e → (∀ k, 0 ≤ e k) → e 0 ≤ Λ →
      (∀ j, e j - e (j + 1) < ε₀ → e (j + 1) ≤ K * (e j - e (j + 1))) →
      ∀ k, e (N + k) ≤ (K / (1 + K)) ^ k * ε₀
goal_type:
∀ {ε₀ K Λ : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε₀ →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 K →
      Real.instLE.le 0 Λ →
        Exists fun N =>
          ∀ (e : Nat → Real),
            Antitone e →
              (∀ (k : Nat), Real.instLE.le 0 (e k)) →
                Real.instLE.le (e 0) Λ →
                  (∀ (j : Nat),
                      Real.instLT.lt (instHSub.hSub (e j) (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))) ε₀ →
                        Real.instLE.le (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))
                          (instHMul.hMul K (instHSub.hSub (e j) (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))))) →
                    ∀ (k : Nat),
                      Real.instLE.le (e (instHAdd.hAdd N k))
                        (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHDiv.hDiv K (instHAdd.hAdd 1 K)) k) ε₀)
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨N, _, hN⟩ := exists_uniform_index_energy_le_of_small_drop
    hε₀ hK hΛ (half_pos hε₀)
  refine ⟨N, fun e he he0 heΛ hdrop k => ?_⟩
  have hdrop0 : ∀ j, e j - e (j + 1) < ε₀ → e (j + 1) ≤ K * (e j - e (j + 1)) + 0 :=
    fun j hj => by rw [add_zero]; exact hdrop j hj
  have heN : e N ≤ ε₀ / 2 + 0 := hN e 0 he he0 heΛ hdrop0
  rw [add_zero] at heN
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa only [add_zero, pow_zero, one_mul] using heN.trans (half_le_self hε₀.le)
  | succ k ih =>
    have hlt : e (N + k) - e (N + k + 1) < ε₀ := by
      have h1 := he0 (N + k + 1)
      have h2 : e (N + k) ≤ ε₀ / 2 := (he (Nat.le_add_right N k)).trans heN
      linarith
    have hstep := hdrop (N + k) hlt
    have hθ : e (N + k + 1) ≤ K / (1 + K) * e (N + k) := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
      nlinarith
    rw [← add_assoc, pow_succ]
    calc e (N + k + 1) ≤ K / (1 + K) * e (N + k) := hθ
      _ ≤ K / (1 + K) * ((K / (1 + K)) ^ k * ε₀) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by positivity)
      _ = (K / (1 + K)) ^ k * (K / (1 + K)) * ε₀ := by ring

docstring: Unconditional isolating disk energy convergence on `[DiscreteTopology M]` targets (`0 unproved`).
signature:
theorem isolating_disk_defect_limit_of_discrete [DiscreteTopology M]
    (u_seq : ℕ → (CP1 → M))
    (h_jhol : ∀ n, JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) (u_seq n) Set.univ)
    (B : ℝ) (thresh : TargetThresholds I M)
    (cdata : ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh)
    (p : CP1) (hp : p ∈ cdata.S)
    (a : ℂ) (_ha : stereo_chart.symm a = p) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r)
    (_h_isol_clos : closure (disk_at a r) ∩ (cdata.S : Set CP1) = {p}) :
    ∃ (m_p : ℝ),
      thresh.ε_sph ≤ m_p ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)) (disk_at a r)) atTop
        (nhds (m_p + energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (disk_at a r)))
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] [DiscreteTopology M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
  (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n) Set.univ) →
    ∀ (B : Real) (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
      (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh) (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
      SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p →
        ∀ (a : Complex),
          Eq (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' a) p →
            ∀ (r : Real),
              Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
                Eq (Set.instInter.inter (closure (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (Finset.instSetLike.coe cdata.S))
                    (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton p) →
                  Exists fun m_p =>
                    And (Real.instLE.le thresh.ε_sph m_p)
                      (Filter.Tendsto
                        (fun n =>
                          GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n)) (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r))
                        Filter.atTop
                        (nhds
                          (instHAdd.hAdd m_p
                            (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I cdata.u₀ (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)))))
proof:
by
  exfalso
  have hS : cdata.S = ∅ := cdata.S_eq_empty_of_discrete I u_seq h_jhol B thresh
  rw [hS] at hp
  exact Finset.notMem_empty p hp

theorem cauchy_deriv_kernel_diff_bound
    {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R)
    {z w ζ : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r)
    (hw : w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r)
    (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = R) :
    ‖((ζ - z) ^ 2)⁻¹ - ((ζ - w) ^ 2)⁻¹‖ ≤ (2 * (R + r) / (R - r) ^ 4) * ‖z - w‖

∀ {r R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      ∀ {z w ζ : Complex},
        Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z →
          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
            Eq (Complex.instNorm.norm ζ) R →
              Real.instLE.le
                (Complex.instNorm.norm
                  (instHSub.hSub (Complex.instInv.inv (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub ζ z) 2))
                    (Complex.instInv.inv (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub ζ w) 2))))
                (instHMul.hMul
                  (instHDiv.hDiv (instHMul.hMul 2 (instHAdd.hAdd R r)) (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub R r) 4))
                  (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)))
proof:

  have _ := hr
  have hz_norm : ‖z‖ ≤ r := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hz
  have hw_norm : ‖w‖ ≤ r := by simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] using hw
  have hRmr_pos : 0 < R - r := sub_pos.mpr hrR
  have hdistz_lo : R - r ≤ ‖ζ - z‖ := by
    have h1 : ‖ζ‖ - ‖z‖ ≤ ‖ζ - z‖ := norm_sub_norm_le ζ z
    linarith
  have hdistw_lo : R - r ≤ ‖ζ - w‖ := by
    have h1 : ‖ζ‖ - ‖w‖ ≤ ‖ζ - w‖ := norm_sub_norm_le ζ w
    linarith
  have hdistz_hi : ‖ζ - z‖ ≤ R + r := by
    have h1 : ‖ζ - z‖ ≤ ‖ζ‖ + ‖z‖ := norm_sub_le ζ z
    linarith
  have hdistw_hi : ‖ζ - w‖ ≤ R + r := by
    have h1 : ‖ζ - w‖ ≤ ‖ζ‖ + ‖w‖ := norm_sub_le ζ w
    linarith
  have hζz_ne : ζ - z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; have : ‖ζ - z‖ = 0 := by simp [h0]

then it converges pointwise on `X` to a continuous limit `g : X → V` and converges uniformly on
every compact subset `K : Set X` (`0 unproved`).
signature:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_of_equicontinuous_of_dense
    {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] {V : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace V] [CompleteSpace V]
    (f : ℕ → X → V) (hequi : Equicontinuous f)
    (d : ℕ → X) (hd : DenseRange d)
    (hconv : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ l : V, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f k (d m)) Filter.atTop (nhds l)) :
    ∃ g : X → V, Continuous g ∧
      ∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → TendstoUniformlyOn f g Filter.atTop K

    ∀ (d : Nat → X),
      DenseRange d →

    intro K hK ε hε
    have hε5 : 0 < ε / 5 := by positivity
    have heq : ∀ x : X, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y : X, dist y x < δ → ∀ k : ℕ, dist (f k x) (f k y) < ε / 5 := by
      intro x

    choose δ hδ_pos hδ using heq
    obtain ⟨t, ht_cov⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover (fun x => Metric.ball x (δ x))

    have h_dense_pt : ∀ x : X, ∃ m : ℕ, dist (d m) x < δ x := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hd.exists_dist_lt x (hδ_pos x)
      exact ⟨m, by rwa [dist_comm]⟩
    choose m hm using h_dense_pt
    have h_cauchy : ∀ x ∈ t, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ N, ∀ l ≥ N, dist (f k (d (m x))) (f l (d (m x))) < ε / 5 := by
      intro x _
      obtain ⟨l_x, hl_x⟩ := hconv (m x)
      exact Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hl_x.cauchySeq (ε / 5) hε5
    choose N_x hN_x using h_cauchy

    refine ⟨N, fun k hk l hl y hy => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxt, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht_cov hy)

      have := Finset.le_sup (f := fun z => if hz : z ∈ t then N_x z hz else 0) hxt

    have d2 : dist (f k x) (f k (d (m x))) < ε / 5 := hδ x (d (m x)) (hm x) k
    have d3 : dist (f k (d (m x))) (f l (d (m x))) < ε / 5 :=
      hN_x x hxt k (le_trans hNx hk) l (le_trans hNx hl)
    have d4 : dist (f l x) (f l (d (m x))) < ε / 5 := hδ x (d (m x)) (hm x) l
    have d5 : dist (f l x) (f l y) < ε / 5 := hδ x y (Metric.mem_ball.mp hyx) l

    intro K hK

    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hunif_cauchy K hK (ε / 2) (by positivity)

    have d2 : dist (f k x) (f k y) < ε / 3 := hδ y hy k

    have t1 := dist_triangle (g y) (f k y) (g x)
    have t2 := dist_triangle (f k y) (f k x) (g x)
    rw [dist_comm (f k y) (f k x)] at t2

            Real.instLE.le 0 (GromovCompactness.Analysis.laplacian2D g w)) →
        Real.instLE.le 0 ρ →
          Real.instLE.le ρ t →
            Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 Real.pi) (g z₀))

    have h_deriv : ∀ s ∈ uIcc 0 ρ,
        HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => g (z₀ + (x : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))) (F s θ) s := by
      intro s hs
      rw [uIcc_of_le hρ0] at hs
      apply hasDerivAt_g_polar_rho g z₀ s θ
      apply differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn g isOpen_ball hg
      apply polar_point_mem_ball θ h_sub
      rw [_root_.abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
      exact hs.2.trans hρt
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt h_deriv hF_θ_int]
    simp

    rw [uIcc_of_le hpi]

  simp only [sub_neg_eq_add, smul_eq_mul] at h_nonneg

name: exp_decay_of_diff_ineq
docstring:
Exponential decay from differential inequality $F(t) \le c \cdot F'(t)$:
If $F : ℝ → ℝ$ is differentiable, $c > 0$, and $F(t) \le c \cdot F'(t)$ for all $t$,
then for any $T \le L$, $F(T) \cdot e^{-T/c} \le F(L) \cdot e^{-L/c}$.
signature:
lemma exp_decay_of_diff_ineq {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (h_ineq : ∀ t, F t ≤ c * deriv F t)
    {T L : ℝ} (hTL : T ≤ L) :
    F T * Real.exp (-T / c) ≤ F L * Real.exp (-L / c)
goal_type:
∀ {F : Real → Real},
  Differentiable Real F →
    ∀ {c : Real},
      Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
        (∀ (t : Real), Real.instLE.le (F t) (instHMul.hMul c (deriv F t))) →
          ∀ {T L : Real},
            Real.instLE.le T L →
              Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (F T) (Real.exp (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.instNeg.neg T) c)))
                (instHMul.hMul (F L) (Real.exp (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.instNeg.neg L) c)))
proof:
by
  have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
  let g := fun t => F t * Real.exp (-t / c)
  have hg_diff : Differentiable ℝ g := by
    apply Differentiable.mul hF
    apply Differentiable.exp
    apply Differentiable.div_const
    exact differentiable_id.neg
  have hg_deriv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv g t := by
    intro t
    have h_inner : HasDerivAt (fun s => -s / c) (-1 / c) t := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => -s) (-1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).neg
      have h2 := h1.div_const c
      simpa using h2
    have h_exp := h_inner.exp
    have h_F : HasDerivAt F (deriv F t) t := (hF t).hasDerivAt
    have h_g : HasDerivAt g (deriv F t * Real.exp (-t / c) + F t * (Real.exp (-t / c) * (-1 / c))) t := h_F.mul h_exp
    have hg_eq : deriv g t = (deriv F t - F t / c) * Real.exp (-t / c) := by
      rw [h_g.deriv]
      ring
    rw [hg_eq]
    have h_pos_exp : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-t / c) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
    have h_diff_nonneg : 0 ≤ deriv F t - F t / c := by
      have h1 := h_ineq t
      have h2 : F t / c ≤ deriv F t := by
        have h3 : F t ≤ c * deriv F t := h1
        exact (div_le_iff₀ hc).mpr (by linarith [mul_comm c (deriv F t)])
      linarith
    exact mul_nonneg h_diff_nonneg h_pos_exp
  have h_mono : Monotone g := monotone_of_deriv_nonneg hg_diff hg_deriv
  exact h_mono hTL

name: ghost_components_bound
docstring:
The Ghost Component Bound Theorem (`gromov_compactness.pdf` Theorem 1 & Task `F06`):
In any stable sphere tree with $|V| > 1$, let $P$ be the number of non-constant components
and $G$ be the number of ghost components ($|V| = P + G$).
For unmarked curves ($k = 0$):
1. $G \le P - 2$
2. $|V| = P + G \le 2P - 2$.
In particular, the total number of components is linearly bounded by the number of non-constant components.
(For general $k$-marked curves, $G \le P + k - 2$ and $|V| \le \max(1, 2P + k - 2) \le \max(1, 2\lfloor B/h \rfloor + k - 2)$).
signature:
theorem ghost_components_bound
    (lim : StableSphereTreeLimit I (M := M))
    (P G : ℕ)
    (h_multivertex : 1 < Fintype.card lim.tree.V)
    (h_P : P = Fintype.card { v : lim.tree.V // is_principal_component I lim v })
    (h_G : G = Fintype.card { v : lim.tree.V // is_ghost_component I lim v }) :
    G ≤ P - 2 ∧ Fintype.card lim.tree.V ≤ 2 * P - 2

∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (P G : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card lim.tree.V) →
    Eq P (Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I lim v)) →
      Eq G (Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v)) →
        And (instLENat.le G (instHSub.hSub P 2))
          (instLENat.le (Fintype.card lim.tree.V) (instHSub.hSub (instHMul.hMul 2 P) 2))
proof:
by
  have h_card_G : G = (Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim)).card := by
    rw [h_G, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_card_P : P = (Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim)).card := by
    rw [h_P, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_prin_eq : Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun v => ¬ is_ghost_component I lim v) := by
    ext v
    simp [is_principal_component]
  have h_sum_cards : (Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim)).card +
      (Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim)).card = Fintype.card lim.tree.V := by
    rw [h_prin_eq, Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not, Finset.card_univ]
  have h_V_eq : Fintype.card lim.tree.V = G + P := by
    rw [h_card_G, h_card_P, h_sum_cards]
  have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset lim.tree.V))
    (p := is_ghost_component I lim) (f := fun v => lim.tree.adj.degree v)
  have h_split_sum : ∑ v : lim.tree.V, lim.tree.adj.degree v =
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v) +
      (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v) := by
    rw [h_prin_eq]
    exact h_split.symm
  have h_ghost_bound : 3 * G ≤ ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
    have h_le : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), (3 : ℕ) ≤
        ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v hv
      have hv_ghost : is_ghost_component I lim v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
      exact lim.stable v hv_ghost
    have h_const : (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim), (3 : ℕ)) =
        3 * (Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component I lim)).card := by
      simp [Finset.sum_const, mul_comm]
    omega
  have h_prin_bound : P ≤ ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
    have h_le : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), (1 : ℕ) ≤
        ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      exact tree_degree_ge_one lim.tree h_multivertex v
    have h_const : (∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim), (1 : ℕ)) =
        (Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I lim)).card := by
      simp [Finset.sum_const]
    omega
  have h_deg_sum := tree_degree_sum lim.tree
  omega

docstring: Two neighbors of a common vertex in a tree cannot be adjacent to each other (Kernel-verified).
signature:
theorem not_adj_of_common_neighbor_in_tree (tree : SphereTree) (root w₁ w₂ : tree.V)
    (hadj₁ : tree.adj.Adj root w₁) (hadj₂ : tree.adj.Adj root w₂) :
    ¬ tree.adj.Adj w₁ w₂
goal_type:
∀ (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root w₁ w₂ : tree.V),
  tree.adj.Adj root w₁ → tree.adj.Adj root w₂ → Not (tree.adj.Adj w₁ w₂)
proof:
by
  intro h₁₂
  let p₁ : tree.adj.Walk root w₂ := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hadj₂ SimpleGraph.Walk.nil
  let p₂ : tree.adj.Walk root w₂ :=
    SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hadj₁ (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons h₁₂ SimpleGraph.Walk.nil)
  have hp₁ : p₁.IsPath := SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (by simp) (by simp [hadj₂.ne])
  have hp₂ : p₂.IsPath := by
    refine SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons ?_ ?_
    · exact SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath.cons (by simp) (by simp [h₁₂.ne])
    · simp [hadj₁.ne, hadj₂.ne]
  have heq : (⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ : tree.adj.Path root w₂) = ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩ :=
    tree.is_tree.isAcyclic.path_unique _ _
  have hlen : p₁.length = p₂.length := congrArg (fun q : tree.adj.Path root w₂ => q.1.length) heq
  dsimp [p₁, p₂] at hlen
  omega

docstring:
Specialization to dilation by factor l > 0:
the Dirichlet energy density scales by exactly l².
signature:
theorem dilation_trace_scaling
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : V → V → ℝ) (hB_add_left : ∀ x y z, B (x + y) z = B x z + B y z)
    (hB_add_right : ∀ x y z, B x (y + z) = B x y + B x z)
    (hB_smul_left : ∀ c x y, B (c • x) y = c * B x y)
    (hB_smul_right : ∀ c x y, B x (c • y) = c * B x y)
    (T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗ[ℝ] V)
    (l : ℝ)
    (K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hKe1 : K e1 = l • e1)
    (hKe2 : K e2 = l • e2) :
    B (T (K e1)) (T (K e1)) + B (T (K e2)) (T (K e2)) =
    l^2 * (B (T e1) (T e1) + B (T e2) (T e2))

    (∀ (x y z : V), Eq (B x (instHAdd.hAdd y z)) (instHAdd.hAdd (B x y) (B x z))) →
      (∀ (c : Real) (x y : V), Eq (B (instHSMul.hSMul c x) y) (instHMul.hMul c (B x y))) →
        (∀ (c : Real) (x y : V), Eq (B x (instHSMul.hSMul c y)) (instHMul.hMul c (B x y))) →
          ∀ (T : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) V) (l : Real)
            (K : LinearMap (RingHom.id Real) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2)) (EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2))),
            Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1) (instHSMul.hSMul l GromovCompactness.e1) →
              Eq (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2) (instHSMul.hSMul l GromovCompactness.e2) →
                Eq
                  (instHAdd.hAdd
                    (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1))
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e1)))
                    (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2))
                      (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe K GromovCompactness.e2))))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow l 2)
                    (instHAdd.hAdd
                      (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e1)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e1))
                      (B (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e2)
                        (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe T GromovCompactness.e2))))

  have hKe2' : K e2 = (-(0 : ℝ)) • e1 + l • e2 := by rw [hKe2, neg_zero, zero_smul, zero_add]
  have h := c_linear_dirichlet_trace_scaling B hB_add_left hB_add_right hB_smul_left hB_smul_right
    T l 0 K hKe1' hKe2'

  exact h

name: constant_map_sobolev_seminorm_mono
docstring: Domain monotonicity of the $L^p$ norm of a constant function on concentric closed balls.
signature:
lemma constant_map_sobolev_seminorm_mono (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (r R : ℝ) (hrR : r ≤ R) (c : ℂ) :
    sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) ≤
    sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) R)
goal_type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 p →
    ∀ (r R : Real),
      Real.instLE.le r R →
        ∀ (c : Complex),
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
            (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevSeminorm p 0 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
proof:
by
  dsimp [sobolevSeminorm]
  have h_norm : (fun z : ℂ => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun _ : ℂ => c) z‖ ^ p) = fun _ => ‖c‖ ^ p := by
    ext z
    simp [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero]
  rw [h_norm]
  have hfi : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℂ => ‖c‖ ^ p) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) volume :=
    integrableOn_const measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne enorm_ne_top
  have hf : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (closedBall (0 : ℂ) R)] (fun _ : ℂ => ‖c‖ ^ p) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) p)
  have hst : closedBall (0 : ℂ) r ≤ᵐ[volume] closedBall (0 : ℂ) R :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun w hw => closedBall_subset_closedBall hrR hw)
  have h_int_le := setIntegral_mono_set hfi hf hst
  have h_int_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ z in closedBall (0 : ℂ) r, ‖c‖ ^ p := by
    apply setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_closedBall
    intro z _
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) p
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow h_int_nonneg h_int_le (one_div_nonneg.mpr hp.le)

theorem constant_map_morrey_embedding (p : ℝ) (_hp : 2 < p) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r) (c : ℂ) :
    ∀ z ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,
    ∀ w ∈ closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,
      ‖(fun _ : ℂ => c) z - (fun _ : ℂ => c) w‖ ≤
        1 * (dist z w)^(1 - 2 / p) * sobolevNorm p 1 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r)

    ∀ (r : Real),

            ∀ (w : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub ((fun x => c) z) ((fun x => c) w)))
                  (instHMul.hMul
                    (instHMul.hMul 1
                      (instHPow.hPow (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z w)
                        (instHSub.hSub 1 (instHDiv.hDiv 2 p))))
                    (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 1 (fun x => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 r)))

  have h_prod : 0 ≤ 1 * (dist z w) ^ (1 - 2 / p) * sobolevNorm p 1 (fun _ => c) (closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) := by
    apply mul_nonneg
    · exact mul_nonneg h1 h2
    · exact h3
  exact h_prod

name: tendstoUniformlyOn_iteratedFDeriv_of_pointwise_of_local_jet_bounds
docstring:
From `SmoothLimits.lean`: if a sequence of smooth maps `f : ℕ → E → F` on an open set `U`
has uniform local jet bounds on compact subsets of `U` and converges pointwise on `U` to `f₀`,
then `f₀` is $C^\infty$ on `U` and for every `r : ℕ` and compact `K ⊆ U`, `iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (f k)`
converges uniformly on `K` to `iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f₀` (`0 unproved`).
signature:
theorem tendstoUniformlyOn_iteratedFDeriv_of_pointwise_of_local_jet_bounds
    {E F : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
    {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (f : ℕ → E → F) (f₀ : E → F)
    (hf : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (f k) U)
    (hbdd : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (f k) x‖ ≤ C)
    (hpoint : ∀ x ∈ U, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f k x) Filter.atTop (nhds (f₀ x))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f₀ U ∧
      ∀ (r : ℕ) (K : Set E), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
        TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (f k))
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f₀) Filter.atTop K
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] [FiniteDimensional Real E]
  [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace Real F] [FiniteDimensional Real F] {U : Set E},
  IsOpen U →
    ∀ (f : Nat → E → F) (f₀ : E → F),
      (∀ (k : Nat), ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) (f k) U) →
        (∀ (r : Nat) (K : Set E),
            IsCompact K →
              Set.instLE.le K U →
                Exists fun C =>
                  ∀ (k : Nat) (x : E),
                    Set.instMembership.mem K x →
                      Real.instLE.le (ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm (iteratedFDeriv Real r (f k) x)) C) →
          (∀ (x : E), Set.instMembership.mem U x → Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f k x) Filter.atTop (nhds (f₀ x))) →
            And (ContDiffOn Real (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) f₀ U)
              (∀ (r : Nat) (K : Set E),
                IsCompact K →
                  Set.instLE.le K U →
                    TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k => iteratedFDeriv Real r (f k)) (iteratedFDeriv Real r f₀) Filter.atTop K)
proof:
by
  classical
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f₀ U := by
    obtain ⟨φ, fLimit, hφ, hfLimit, hconv⟩ := exists_cInf_subseq_on hU f hf hbdd
    apply hfLimit.congr
    intro x hx
    have hto₀ := (hpoint x hx).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
    have htoLimit : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f (φ k) x) Filter.atTop (nhds (fLimit x)) := by
      have h0 := (hconv 0 {x} isCompact_singleton (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx)).tendsto_at
        (Set.mem_singleton x)
      have hev := ((continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ E F).continuous.tendsto _).comp h0
      simpa [Function.comp_def, iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp] using hev
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hto₀ htoLimit
  refine ⟨hsmooth, fun r K hK hKU => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
  intro ε hε
  by_contra hbad
  rw [Filter.not_eventually] at hbad
  have hfreq : ∃ k : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono k ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ x ∈ K, ε ≤ dist (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f₀ x) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r (f (k n)) x) := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk_mono, hk_prop⟩ := Filter.extraction_of_frequently_atTop hbad
    refine ⟨k, hk_mono, fun n => ?_⟩
    have hn := hk_prop n
    push Not at hn
    exact hn
  obtain ⟨k, hk_mono, hk_bad⟩ := hfreq
  choose x hx hdist using hk_bad
  obtain ⟨σ, fLimit, hσ, _, hconv⟩ := exists_cInf_subseq_on hU
    (fun n => f (k n)) (fun n => hf (k n)) (by
      intro j C hC hCU
      obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbdd j C hC hCU
      exact ⟨B, fun n y hy => hB (k n) y hy⟩)
  have heq : Set.EqOn f₀ fLimit U := by
    intro y hy
    have hto₀ := (hpoint y hy).comp (hk_mono.tendsto_atTop.comp hσ.tendsto_atTop)
    have htoLimit : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f (k (σ n)) y) Filter.atTop (nhds (fLimit y)) := by
      have h0 := (hconv 0 {y} isCompact_singleton (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hy)).tendsto_at
        (Set.mem_singleton y)
      have hev := ((continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ E F).continuous.tendsto _).comp h0
      simpa [Function.comp_def, iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp] using hev
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hto₀ htoLimit
  have hid_deriv : ∀ y ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ r f₀ y = iteratedFDeriv ℝ r fLimit y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen r hU hy,
        ← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen r hU hy]
    exact iteratedFDerivWithin_congr heq hy r
  have hunif := Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mp (hconv r K hK hKU) ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hunif
  have hlt := hN N le_rfl (x (σ N)) (hx (σ N))
  rw [← hid_deriv (x (σ N)) (hKU (hx (σ N)))] at hlt
  exact not_lt_of_ge (hdist (σ N)) hlt

theorem fderiv_directional_cauchyRiemann_identity
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (ζ w : ℂ) :
    fderiv ℝ f ζ w + Complex.I * fderiv ℝ f ζ (Complex.I * w) =
      2 * (starRingEnd ℂ w) * cauchyRiemann f ζ
goal_type:
∀ (f : Complex → Complex) (ζ w : Complex),
  Eq
    (instHAdd.hAdd (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f ζ) w)
      (instHMul.hMul Complex.I (ContinuousLinearMap.funLike.coe (fderiv Real f ζ) (instHMul.hMul Complex.I w))))
    (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul 2 (RingHom.instFunLike.coe (starRingEnd Complex) w))
      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f ζ))
proof:
by
  set L := fderiv ℝ f ζ with hL
  have hw_decomp : w = (w.re : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) + (w.im : ℝ) • Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  have hIw_decomp : Complex.I * w = (-w.im : ℝ) • (1 : ℂ) + (w.re : ℝ) • Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  have hLw : L w = (w.re : ℂ) * L 1 + (w.im : ℂ) * L Complex.I := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hw_decomp]
    rw [L.map_add, L.map_smul, L.map_smul]
    simp [Complex.real_smul]
  have hLIw : L (Complex.I * w) = (-w.im : ℂ) * L 1 + (w.re : ℂ) * L Complex.I := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hIw_decomp]
    rw [L.map_add, L.map_smul, L.map_smul]
    simp [Complex.real_smul]
  have hstar : starRingEnd ℂ w = (w.re : ℂ) - (w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp
  dsimp [cauchyRiemann]
  rw [← hL, hLw, hLIw, hstar]
  calc
    (w.re : ℂ) * L 1 + (w.im : ℂ) * L Complex.I +
        Complex.I * (-(w.im : ℂ) * L 1 + (w.re : ℂ) * L Complex.I)
      = (w.re : ℂ) * L 1 - (w.im : ℂ) * (Complex.I * Complex.I) * L Complex.I +
        Complex.I * (-(w.im : ℂ) * L 1 + (w.re : ℂ) * L Complex.I) := by
          rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; ring
    _ = 2 * ((w.re : ℂ) - (w.im : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
          (1 / 2 * (L 1 + Complex.I * L Complex.I)) := by ring

    apply Finset.sum_nonneg

    exact norm_nonneg _

    (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) \ {0}, sSup ((fun z => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ x f z‖) '' s)) +
    derivHolderSeminorm k α f s
  have h_id : supNormOn f s = sSup ((fun z => ‖f z‖) '' s) := rfl
  rw [h_id]

name: mu_eq_zero_of_nonpos_B
docstring: Whenever `B ≤ 0`, the weak limit measure `cdata.μ` vanishes identically (`0 unproved`).
signature:
theorem ConcentrationData.mu_eq_zero_of_nonpos_B
    (u_seq : ℕ → (CP1 → M)) (B : ℝ) (thresh : TargetThresholds I M)
    (cdata : ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh)
    (hB : B ≤ 0) :
    cdata.μ = 0
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (thresh : GromovCompactness.Analysis.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B thresh), Real.instLE.le B 0 → Eq cdata.μ 0
proof:
by
  have h_univ_zero : cdata.μ Set.univ = 0 := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ zero_le'
    calc cdata.μ Set.univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B := cdata.μ_total_le
      _ = 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos hB
  exact Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero.mp h_univ_zero

(Kernel-verified) conditional reduction of `resolve_single_defect_tree` across sub-threshold masses
(`m_defect < thresh.h`), leaf bubbles, and one-level decompositions (`0 unproved`).

theorem resolve_single_defect_tree_of_cases
    (thresh : TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m_defect) (base_val : M)
    (h_cases : m_defect < thresh.h ∨
      (thresh.h ≤ m_defect ∧
        ∃ v : CP1 → M,
          JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) v Set.univ ∧
          m_defect = totalEnergy I v ∧
          v north_pole = base_val ∧
          energyMeasure I v (disk_at 0 1) = m_defect - thresh.h / 2) ∨
      (thresh.h ≤ m_defect ∧
        ∃ decomp : OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val,
          decomp.q = ∅ ∨
          (∀ z ∈ decomp.q, Nonempty (LocalDefectTree I thresh (decomp.m_child z) (decomp.v (stereo_chart.symm z)))))) :
    Nonempty (LocalDefectTree I thresh m_defect base_val)
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)

  Real.instLT.lt 0 m_defect →
    ∀ (base_val : M),
      Or (Real.instLT.lt m_defect thresh.h)
          (Or
            (And (Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect)
              (Exists fun v =>
                And (GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 v Set.univ)
                  (And (Eq m_defect (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I v))
                    (And (Eq (v GromovCompactness.north_pole) base_val)
                      (Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1))
                        (instHSub.hSub m_defect (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)))))))
            (And (Real.instLE.le thresh.h m_defect)
              (Exists fun decomp =>
                Or (Eq decomp.q Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
                  (∀ (z : Complex),
                    SetLike.instMembership.mem decomp.q z →
                      Nonempty
                        (GromovCompactness.Bubbling.LocalDefectTree I thresh (decomp.m_child z)

    (pdata : PrestableLimitData I u_seq)
    (w₁ w₂ : pdata.tree.V)

    (hK_comp : IsCompact K) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n => (MoebiusFrame.comp (MoebiusFrame.inv (pdata.frames v.1 n)) (pdata.frames w.1 n)).toHomeo)

    have ho1 : origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root v w = pdata.root := if_neg hadj
    have ho2 : origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root w v = pdata.root := if_neg hadj_symm

    let hw_orig := origNeighbor_adj pdata.tree pdata.root w₁ w₂ hadj₁ hadj₂ w v

        exact pdata.tree.node_distinct pdata.root v.1 w.1

        (MoebiusFrame.comp (MoebiusFrame.inv (pdata.frames v.1 n))
          (pdata.frames (origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root v w) n)).toHomeo
        ((MoebiusFrame.comp (MoebiusFrame.inv (pdata.frames (origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root w v) n))
          (pdata.frames w.1 n)).toHomeo x)) := by
      funext n; funext x
      have h_eq_orig : origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root v w =
          origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root w v := ho1.trans ho2.symm
      rw [h_eq_orig]
      exact moebius_comp_cancel_middle _ _ _ x
    rw [h_comp_eq]
    exact tendstoUniformlyOn_comp_of_tendsto_const hp_ne hf_col hg_col

          Real.instLE.le 0 M →
            MonotoneOn E (Set.Ioc 0 R) →

                  Real.instLE.le (E (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow θ n) R))
