name: has_energy_defect_iff_concentration
docstring:
Contract B01: Equivalence between defect atom and energy concentration.
When the regular part of the limit measure is atomless (e.g. continuous energy density
of a smooth J-holomorphic curve), the defect measure has an atom of mass ≥ ε₀ at x
if and only if every metric neighborhood of x concentrates energy ≥ ε₀.
signature:
theorem has_energy_defect_iff_concentration
    (μ_reg ν_defect : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ_reg] [IsFiniteMeasure ν_defect]
    (h_reg_null : ∀ x, μ_reg {x} = 0) (x : X) (ε₀ : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ ν_defect {x} ↔
    ∀ r > 0, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ (μ_reg + ν_defect) (closedBall x r)
goal_type:
∀ {X : Type u_4} [inst : MetricSpace X] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
  (μ_reg ν_defect : MeasureTheory.Measure X) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ_reg]
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν_defect],
  (∀ (x : X), Eq (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ_reg (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton x)) 0) →
    ∀ (x : X) (ε₀ : Real),
      Iff
        (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀)
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe ν_defect (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton x)))
        (∀ (r : Real),
          GT.gt r 0 →
            ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀)
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (instHAdd.hAdd μ_reg ν_defect) (Metric.closedBall x r)))
proof:
by
  have h_sum_atom : (μ_reg + ν_defect) {x} = ν_defect {x} := by
    simp only [Measure.add_apply, h_reg_null x, zero_add]
  have h_equiv := atom_iff_concentration (X := X) (μ := μ_reg + ν_defect) x ε₀
  rw [h_sum_atom] at h_equiv
  exact h_equiv

    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),

        ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
          Eq (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w)

  have hz_in_ball : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r := by

    have h_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) := isCompact_closedBall 0 r

  have he_ae_zero : e =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r)] 0 := by

    Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq he_ae_zero isOpen_ball he_cont_ball continuousOn_const

      ENNReal.ofReal p.1 * ENNReal.ofReal (sphericalJacobian (Complex.polarCoord.symm p)) =

    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r,
      ‖cauchyRiemann f z‖ ≤ 2 * ckHolderNorm 0 α (dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r,
      ‖cauchyRiemann f z - cauchyRiemann f w‖ ≤
        (2 * ckHolderNorm 0 α (dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R)) * ‖z - w‖ ^ α)

                                  (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f w)))
                              (instHPow.hPow (Complex.instNorm.norm (instHSub.hSub z w)) α)))))) →
            And

                Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z →
                  Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f z))
                    (instHMul.hMul 2
                      (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm 0 α (GromovCompactness.Analysis.dbarComplex f)
                        (Metric.ball 0 R))))

theorem moebiusMatrix_mul_left_cancel (A B₁ B₂ : MoebiusMatrix)
    (h : MoebiusMatrix.mul A B₁ = MoebiusMatrix.mul A B₂) : B₁ = B₂
goal_type: ∀ (A B₁ B₂ : GromovCompactness.MoebiusMatrix), Eq (A.mul B₁) (A.mul B₂) → Eq B₁ B₂
proof:
by
  have ha : (A.a * B₁.a + A.b * B₁.c) = (A.a * B₂.a + A.b * B₂.c) := by injection h
  have hb : (A.a * B₁.b + A.b * B₁.d) = (A.a * B₂.b + A.b * B₂.d) := by injection h
  have hc : (A.c * B₁.a + A.d * B₁.c) = (A.c * B₂.a + A.d * B₂.c) := by injection h
  have hd : (A.c * B₁.b + A.d * B₁.d) = (A.c * B₂.b + A.d * B₂.d) := by injection h
  have hdet := A.det_ne_zero
  have h_a_diff : (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₁.a = (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₂.a := by
    linear_combination A.d * ha - A.b * hc
  have h_a : B₁.a = B₂.a := mul_left_cancel₀ hdet h_a_diff
  have h_b_diff : (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₁.b = (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₂.b := by
    linear_combination A.d * hb - A.b * hd
  have h_b : B₁.b = B₂.b := mul_left_cancel₀ hdet h_b_diff
  have h_c_diff : (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₁.c = (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₂.c := by
    linear_combination -A.c * ha + A.a * hc
  have h_c : B₁.c = B₂.c := mul_left_cancel₀ hdet h_c_diff
  have h_d_diff : (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₁.d = (A.a * A.d - A.b * A.c) * B₂.d := by
    linear_combination -A.c * hb + A.a * hd
  have h_d : B₁.d = B₂.d := mul_left_cancel₀ hdet h_d_diff
  exact MoebiusMatrix.ext h_a h_b h_c h_d

name: heinz_maximum_interior
docstring:
When the integral of `e` on `ball 0 r` is strictly positive, any Heinz maximizer `z₀`
lies in the open ball `ball 0 r` and satisfies `0 < e z₀`.
signature:
lemma heinz_maximum_interior (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r) (e : ℂ → ℝ)
    (he_nonneg : ∀ z, 0 ≤ e z)
    (h_pos : 0 < ∫ w in Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, e w)
    (z₀ : ℂ) (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r)
    (h_max : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall 0 r, (r - ‖w‖)^2 * e w ≤ (r - ‖z₀‖)^2 * e z₀) :
    z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r ∧ 0 < e z₀
goal_type:
∀ (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    ∀ (e : Complex → Real),
      (∀ (z : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (e z)) →
        Real.instLT.lt 0
            (MeasureTheory.integral (measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace.volume.restrict (Metric.ball 0 r)) fun w => e w) →
          ∀ (z₀ : Complex),
            Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) z₀ →
              (∀ (w : Complex),
                  Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                    Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm w)) 2) (e w))
                      (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm z₀)) 2) (e z₀))) →
                And (Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball 0 r) z₀) (Real.instLT.lt 0 (e z₀))
proof:
by
  have h_max_val : 0 < (r - ‖z₀‖)^2 * e z₀ := by
    by_contra h_le_zero
    push_neg at h_le_zero
    have h_zero_max : (r - ‖z₀‖)^2 * e z₀ = 0 := by
      have h1 : 0 ≤ (r - ‖z₀‖)^2 * e z₀ := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (he_nonneg z₀)
      linarith
    have h_all_zero : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r, e w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      have hw_closed : w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw
      have h_bound := h_max w hw_closed
      rw [h_zero_max] at h_bound
      have h_nonneg_w : 0 ≤ (r - ‖w‖)^2 * e w := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (he_nonneg w)
      have h_eq_zero : (r - ‖w‖)^2 * e w = 0 := le_antisymm h_bound h_nonneg_w
      have hw_dist : ‖w‖ < r := by
        have := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
        rwa [dist_zero_right] at this
      have h_diff_pos : 0 < r - ‖w‖ := by linarith
      have h_sq_pos : 0 < (r - ‖w‖)^2 := sq_pos_of_pos h_diff_pos
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_eq_zero).resolve_left h_sq_pos.ne'

name: interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate
docstring:
**Contract A04a (Interior Cauchy–Riemann Schauder Estimate in $C^{k,\alpha}$)**:
On concentric disks $D_r \subset D_R \subset \mathbb{C}$ ($0 < r < R$) and for $\alpha \in (0, 1)$,
the $C^{k+1,\alpha}$ Hölder norm of a $C^{k+1}$ map $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ on $D_r$ satisfying
the Schauder regularity certificate `SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R f` is controlled
by the $C^{k,\alpha}$ norm of $\bar{\partial} f$ on $D_R$ together with the $C^0$ norm of $f$ on $D_R$:
$$\|f\|_{C^{k+1,\alpha}(D_r)} \le C \left(\|\bar{\partial} f\|_{C^{k,\alpha}(D_R)} + \|f\|_{C^0(D_R)}\right).$$
signature:
theorem interior_cauchy_riemann_estimate
    (k : ℕ) (α r R : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ (k + 1) f (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) R) →
      SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R f →
      ckHolderNorm (k + 1) α f (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) r) ≤
        C * (ckHolderNorm k α (dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) +
             supNormOn f (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R))
goal_type:

            And (GT.gt C 0)
              (∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
                ContDiffOn Real (instHAdd.hAdd k.cast 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) →
                  GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R f →
                    Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) α f (Metric.ball 0 r))

                            (Metric.ball 0 R))

then `Metric.diam (Set.image u s) < η` (`0 unproved`).

    (u : CP1 → M) (s : Set CP1) (x : M) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η)

      Real.instLT.lt (Metric.diam (Set.image u s)) η

  have h_le : Metric.diam (Set.image u s) ≤ 2 * (η / 3) := by

    have h_tri : dist (u z) (u w) ≤ dist (u z) x + dist (u w) x :=
      dist_triangle_right (u z) (u w) x
    linarith
  linarith

  have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num

name: norm_cauchyRiemann_le_norm_fderiv
docstring: First-order Cauchy–Riemann operator norm is bounded by the full real Fréchet derivative norm (Kernel-verified).
signature:
theorem norm_cauchyRiemann_le_norm_fderiv (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖cauchyRiemann f z‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖
goal_type:
∀ (f : Complex → Complex) (z : Complex),
  Real.instLE.le (Complex.instNorm.norm (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f z))
    (ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm.norm (fderiv Real f z))
proof:
by
  dsimp [cauchyRiemann]
  have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ f z 1‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ := by
    simpa using (fderiv ℝ f z).le_opNorm (1 : ℂ)
  have hI : ‖fderiv ℝ f z Complex.I‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ := by
    simpa [Complex.norm_I] using (fderiv ℝ f z).le_opNorm Complex.I
  calc ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ f z 1 + Complex.I * fderiv ℝ f z Complex.I)‖
      = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖fderiv ℝ f z 1 + Complex.I * fderiv ℝ f z Complex.I‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul, norm_div, norm_one, Complex.norm_ofNat]
    _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (‖fderiv ℝ f z 1‖ + ‖Complex.I * fderiv ℝ f z Complex.I‖) := by
        gcongr
        exact norm_add_le _ _
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (‖fderiv ℝ f z 1‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ f z Complex.I‖) := by
        rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
    _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ := by linarith

theorem polar_cauchy_pompeiu_representation
    {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf_diff : ∀ ρ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 R, ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))))
    (h_int_ang_rad : ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 R,
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun θ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))
          (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (h_int_ang_ang : ∀ ρ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 R,
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun θ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))
          (Complex.I * ((ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))))) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (h_int_rad : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi),
      IntervalIntegrable
        (fun r : ℝ => fderiv ℝ f (z + (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))
          (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))) volume 0 R)
    (h_int_bdry : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun θ : ℝ => f (z + (R : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi))
    (h_fubini :
      (∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..R,
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          fderiv ℝ f (z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))
            (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))))) =
      (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
        (∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..R,
          fderiv ℝ f (z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))
            (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))))) :
    f z =
      ((2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)⁻¹) * (∮ ζ in C(z, R), (ζ - z)⁻¹ * f ζ) -
        ((Real.pi : ℂ)⁻¹) * (∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..R,
          (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
            (ρ : ℂ) * (cauchyRiemann f (z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))) /

  Real.instLT.lt 0 R →

          (∀ (θ : Real),

                    (instHMul.hMul (Complex.instInv.inv (Complex.ofReal Real.pi))

by
  have h_pompeiu_eq :
      (∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..R,
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),

            ((z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))) - z)))) =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..R,
        (∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          fderiv ℝ f (z + (ρ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ)))
            (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))))) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards with ρ hρ_mem
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hR.le] at hρ_mem
    have hρ_cc : ρ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 R := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hR.le]
      exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hρ_mem
    exact polar_pompeiu_angular_slice_identity hρ_mem.1 (hf_diff ρ hρ_cc)
      (h_int_ang_rad ρ hρ_mem) (h_int_ang_ang ρ hρ_mem)
  rw [h_pompeiu_eq, h_fubini]
  have hf_diff_swap : ∀ θ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 (2 * Real.pi), ∀ r ∈ Set.uIcc 0 R,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z + (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (θ : ℂ))) :=
    fun θ hθ r hr => hf_diff r hr θ hθ
  rw [polar_radial_angular_ftc_eq_sub hf_diff_swap h_int_rad h_int_bdry]
  rw [circleIntegral_sub_center_inv_eq_average f z (ne_of_gt hR)]
  have hpi_ne : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hI_ne : (Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.I_ne_zero
  field_simp [hpi_ne, hI_ne]
  ring

theorem satisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann_of_le_sum
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (k : ℕ) (r R : ℝ) (hrR : 0 < r ∧ r < R)
    (f : ℂ → ℂ)
    (h_le : sobolevNorm p (k + 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r) ≤
      sobolevNorm p k (cauchyRiemann f) (Metric.closedBall 0 R) +
        sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R)) :
    SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann p k r R f
goal_type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
        ∀ (f : Complex → Complex),
          Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p (instHAdd.hAdd k 1) f (Metric.closedBall 0 r))
              (instHAdd.hAdd
                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p k (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f)
                  (Metric.closedBall 0 R))
                (GromovCompactness.Analysis.sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R))) →
            GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann p k r R f
proof:
by
  dsimp [SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann]
  have hp1 : 0 < p - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hp
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_trans hrR.1 hrR.2
  have hSub_pos : 0 < R - r := sub_pos.mpr hrR.2
  have h_extra : 0 ≤ p / (p - 1) * (R / (R - r)) ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
  have h_rhs_nonneg : 0 ≤ sobolevNorm p k (cauchyRiemann f) (Metric.closedBall 0 R) +
      sobolevNorm p 0 f (Metric.closedBall 0 R) := by
    apply add_nonneg
    · exact sobolevNorm_nonneg p k _ _ measurableSet_closedBall
    · exact sobolevNorm_nonneg p 0 _ _ measurableSet_closedBall
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h_extra h_rhs_nonneg]

chart energy density (`0 unproved`).

    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
    {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    [IsManifold I ∞ M] [CompactSpace M] [ClosedTameTarget I M]
    (h_all : ∀ (u : CP1 → M),
      JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) u Set.univ →
      ∃ c₀ : ℝ, (fun z => riemannianEnergyDensity I u (stereo_chart.symm z)) = fun _ => c₀) :
    ∃ (b c : ℝ), 0 ≤ b ∧ 0 ≤ c ∧
      ∀ (u : CP1 → M),
        JHolomorphicOn (I := I) (I_dom := I_CP1) u Set.univ →
        ∀ (w : ℂ),
          ∃ (hessNorm : ℝ) (curvTerm : ℝ),
            laplacian2D (fun z => riemannianEnergyDensity I u (stereo_chart.symm z)) w =
              hessNorm ^ 2 + curvTerm ∧
            |curvTerm| ≤
              b * (riemannianEnergyDensity I u (stereo_chart.symm w)) ^ 2 +
              c * (riemannianEnergyDensity I u (stereo_chart.symm w))

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M],
  (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
      GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →
        Exists fun c₀ =>
          Eq (fun z => GromovCompactness.riemannianEnergyDensity I u (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' z))
            fun x => c₀) →
    Exists fun b =>
      Exists fun c =>
        And (Real.instLE.le 0 b)
          (And (Real.instLE.le 0 c)
            (∀ (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M),
              GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 u Set.univ →

                            (fun z =>

                                  (GromovCompactness.stereo_chart.symm.toFun' w))
                                2))

name: marked_ghost_components_bound
docstring:
The Ghost Component Bound Theorem for $k$-marked stable sphere trees:
In any marked stable sphere tree with $|V| > 1$, $G \le P + k - 2$ (Kernel-verified).
signature:
theorem marked_ghost_components_bound {k : ℕ}
    (u_lim : MarkedStableTreeLimit I (M := M) k)
    (P G : ℕ)
    (h_multi : 1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V)
    (hP : P = Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v })
    (hG : G = Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v }) :
    G ≤ P + k - 2
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat}
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k) (P G : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) →
    Eq P (Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.Extensions.is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v)) →
      Eq G (Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.Extensions.is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v)) →
        instLENat.le G (instHSub.hSub (instHAdd.hAdd P k) 2)
proof:
by
  let s_prin := Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component_marked I u_lim)
  let s_ghost := Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim)
  have hP' : P = s_prin.card := by rw [hP, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have hG' : G = s_ghost.card := by rw [hG, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_prin_eq : s_prin = Finset.univ.filter (fun v => ¬ is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v) := by
    ext v
    simp [is_principal_component_marked, s_prin]
  have h_sum_cards : s_ghost.card + s_prin.card = Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := by
    rw [h_prin_eq, Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not, Finset.card_univ]
  have h_V_eq : Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V = G + P := by
    omega
  have h_split := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := (Finset.univ : Finset u_lim.tree.V))
    (p := is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim) (f := fun v => u_lim.tree.adj.degree v)

      (∑ v ∈ s_ghost, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v) +
      (∑ v ∈ s_prin, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v) := by
    rw [h_prin_eq]
    exact h_split.symm
  have h_deg_sum := tree_degree_sum u_lim.tree
  have h_prin_bound : P ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_prin, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
    have h_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, (1 : ℕ) ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_prin, u_lim.tree.adj.degree v := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      exact tree_degree_ge_one u_lim.tree h_multi v
    have h_const : (∑ v ∈ s_prin, (1 : ℕ)) = s_prin.card := by
      simp [Finset.sum_const]

name: card_le_of_atoms
docstring: Finite sum bound on atoms: Any finite set of atoms of mass ≥ ε₀ satisfies |S| * ε₀ ≤ E₀.
signature:
theorem card_le_of_atoms
    (μ : Measure α) (E₀ ε₀ : ℝ) (hE₀ : 0 ≤ E₀) (h_tot : μ univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal E₀)
    (S : Finset α) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ μ {x}) :
    (S.card : ℝ) * ε₀ ≤ E₀
goal_type:
∀ {α : Type u_4} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (E₀ ε₀ : Real),
  Real.instLE.le 0 E₀ →
    ENNReal.instLE.le (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ Set.univ) (ENNReal.ofReal E₀) →
      ∀ (S : Finset α),
        (∀ (x : α),
            SetLike.instMembership.mem S x →
              ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀)
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton x))) →
          Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul S.card.cast ε₀) E₀
proof:
by
  have h_meas : ∀ b ∈ S, MeasurableSet ({b} : Set α) :=
    fun b _ => measurableSet_singleton b
  have h_disj : (S : Set α).PairwiseDisjoint (fun x => ({x} : Set α)) := by
    intro x _ y _ hne
    exact disjoint_singleton.mpr hne
  have h_sum_eq := measure_biUnion_finset h_disj h_meas (μ := μ)
  have h_le_univ : μ (⋃ b ∈ S, ({b} : Set α)) ≤ μ (univ : Set α) :=
    measure_mono (subset_univ _)
  have h_sum_le : (∑ x ∈ S, μ {x}) ≤ μ (univ : Set α) := by
    rw [← h_sum_eq]
    exact h_le_univ
  have h_sum_bound : (∑ x ∈ S, μ {x}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal E₀ :=
    h_sum_le.trans h_tot
  have h1 : ∑ x ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ ∑ x ∈ S, μ {x} :=
    sum_le_sum (fun x hx => hS x hx)
  rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h_mul_le := h1.trans h_sum_bound
  have h_rw : (S.card : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ = ENNReal.ofReal ((S.card : ℝ) * ε₀) := by
    have h_c : (S.card : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal (S.card : ℝ) := by simp
    rw [h_c, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  rw [h_rw] at h_mul_le
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hE₀).mp h_mul_le

lemma heinz_maximum_exists (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (e : ℂ → ℝ)
    (he_cont : ContinuousOn e (Metric.closedBall 0 r)) :
    ∃ z₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,
      ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r,
        (r - ‖w‖)^2 * e w ≤ (r - ‖z₀‖)^2 * e z₀

            (∀ (w : Complex),
              Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.closedBall 0 r) w →
                Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm w)) 2) (e w))
                  (instHMul.hMul (instHPow.hPow (instHSub.hSub r (Complex.instNorm.norm z₀)) 2) (e z₀)))

by
  have h_comp : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r) := isCompact_closedBall 0 r
  have h_nonempty : (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) r).Nonempty := ⟨0, Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (by simp [hr.le])⟩

    apply ContinuousOn.mul
    · have h_norm : ContinuousOn (fun w : ℂ => r - ‖w‖) (Metric.closedBall 0 r) :=

  exact ⟨z₀, hz₀_mem, hz₀_max⟩

docstring: Full component and vertex bounds for any $k$-marked stable sphere tree limit (Contract E02 integration, (Kernel-verified).
signature:
theorem marked_component_count_bounds {k : ℕ}
    (th : Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
    (u_lim : MarkedStableTreeLimit I (M := M) k) (B : ℝ)
    (h_energy : markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim ≤ B) :
    let P
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k) (B : Real),
  Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) B →
    have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.Extensions.is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v);
    have G := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.Extensions.is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v);
    And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul P.cast th.h) B)
      (And (instLTNat.lt 1 (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) → instLENat.le G (instHSub.hSub (instHAdd.hAdd P k) 2))
        (Int.instLEInt.le (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V).cast

            (instHSub.hSub (instHAdd.hAdd (instHMul.hMul 2 (Int.floor (instHDiv.hDiv B th.h))) k.cast) 2))))

    let G := Fintype.card { v : u_lim.tree.V // is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v }
    (P * th.h ≤ B) ∧
    (1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V → G ≤ P + k - 2) ∧
    ((Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ max 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2)) := by
  intro P G
  let s_prin := Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component_marked I u_lim)
  have hP : P = s_prin.card := by
    dsimp [P, s_prin]
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_each : ∀ v ∈ s_prin, th.h ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv_prin : is_principal_component_marked I u_lim v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hv_nonconst : ¬ ∃ c : M, ∀ z : CP1, u_lim.map v z = c := hv_prin
    have h_sph := th.h_sph (u_lim.map v) (u_lim.is_jhol v) hv_nonconst
    exact th.h_le_sph.trans h_sph
  have h_sum_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, th.h ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_prin, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
  have h_const_sum : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, th.h = (P : ℝ) * th.h := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hP]
  rw [h_const_sum] at h_sum_le
  have h_nonneg : ∀ v : u_lim.tree.V, 0 ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v
    exact energy_nonneg I (u_lim.map v) Set.univ

      ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg
    intro i
    exact h_nonneg i
  have h_P_energy : (P : ℝ) * th.h ≤ B :=
    h_sum_le.trans (h_sub_le.trans h_energy)
  refine ⟨h_P_energy, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h_multi
    exact marked_ghost_components_bound I u_lim P G h_multi rfl rfl
  · by_cases h_multi : 1 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V
    · have h_G_le := marked_ghost_components_bound I u_lim P G h_multi rfl rfl
      let s_ghost := Finset.univ.filter (is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim)
      have hG : G = s_ghost.card := by
        dsimp [G, s_ghost]
        rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
      have h_prin_eq : s_prin = Finset.univ.filter (fun v => ¬ is_ghost_component_marked I u_lim v) := by
        ext v
        simp [is_principal_component_marked, s_prin]
      have h_sum_cards : s_ghost.card + s_prin.card = Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := by
        rw [h_prin_eq, Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not, Finset.card_univ]
      have h_V_eq : Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V = G + P := by
        omega
      have h_P_le_div : (P : ℝ) ≤ B / th.h := by
        rwa [le_div_iff₀ th.h_pos]
      have h_P_le_floor : (P : ℤ) ≤ ⌊B / th.h⌋ := by
        rw [Int.le_floor]
        exact h_P_le_div
      have h_card_le : (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ 2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2 := by
        have h1 : (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V : ℤ) ≤ 2 * (P : ℤ) + (k : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
        linarith
      exact h_card_le.trans (le_max_right 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2))
    · have h_card1 : Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V = 1 := by
        have h_pos : 0 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := Fintype.card_pos
        omega
      rw [h_card1]
      push_cast
      exact le_max_left 1 (2 * ⌊B / th.h⌋ + (k : ℤ) - 2)

theorem extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv
    (u_seq : ℕ → (CP1 → M)) (B : ℝ) (th : Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
    (cdata : Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
    (m_defect : CP1 → ℝ)
    (P : PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S)
    (h_root : (cdata.S = ∅ ∧
      (Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n))) atTop
          (𝓝 (totalEnergy I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, m_defect p)) ∨
        ∃ (τ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
          Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).1 n))) atTop
            (𝓝 (totalEnergy I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, m_defect p)))) ∨
      (∃ (σ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (res : TreeRescalingData P.tree P.root),
        (∀ (v : P.tree.V),
          SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)) ∘ (globalFrameAt P.tree P.root res v n).toHomeo)
            (P.map v)
            (punctured_sphere { z | ∃ (w : P.tree.V) (h : P.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = P.tree.node_point v w h })) ∧
        Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n))) atTop
          (𝓝 (totalEnergy I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, m_defect p)))) :
    ∃ (σ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (res : TreeRescalingData P.tree P.root),
      (∀ (frames : (v : P.tree.V) → ℕ → MoebiusFrame),
        (∀ n, frames P.root n = MoebiusFrame.id) →
        (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : w ≠ P.root) (n : ℕ),
          frames w n = MoebiusFrame.comp (frames (res.parent w hw) n)
            (affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) (res.scale_pos w n))) →
        ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
          SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)) ∘ (frames v n).toHomeo)
            (P.map v)
            (punctured_sphere { z | ∃ (w : P.tree.V) (h : P.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = P.tree.node_point v w h })) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n))) atTop
        (𝓝 (totalEnergy I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, m_defect p))

  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  Or
      (And (Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection)
        (Or
          (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

              (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))))

                (fun n =>
                  Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n))
                    (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (GromovCompactness.Assembly.globalFrameAt P.tree P.root res v n).toHomeo))
                (P.map v)
                (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere

            (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop

                    (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                      (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
          (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))

docstring: Portmanteau, null-frontier sets, finite measures.
signature:
theorem tendsto_measure_of_null_frontier_finite [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    (μ : ℕ → Measure X) [∀ n, IsFiniteMeasure (μ n)] (ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h : ∀ f : C(X, ℝ), Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, f x ∂(μ n)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂ν)))
    (A : Set X) (hA : ν (frontier A) = 0) : Tendsto (fun n => μ n A) atTop (𝓝 (ν A))
goal_type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
  (μ : Nat → MeasureTheory.Measure X) [∀ (n : Nat), MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure (μ n)] (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν],
  (∀ (f : ContinuousMap X Real),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.integral (μ n) fun x => ContinuousMap.instFunLike.coe f x) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (MeasureTheory.integral ν fun x => ContinuousMap.instFunLike.coe f x))) →
    ∀ (A : Set X),
      Eq (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe ν (frontier A)) 0 →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe (μ n) A) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe ν A))
proof:
by
  have hclosed := fun (K : Set X) (hK : IsClosed K) =>
    limsup_closed_le_of_tendsto_integral μ ν h K hK
  have upper : ∀ K : Set X, IsClosed K → ∀ ε > 0,
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (μ n K).toReal ≤ (ν K).toReal + ε := by
    intro K hK ε hε
    have hlt : limsup (fun n => μ n K) atTop < ν K + ENNReal.ofReal ε :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (hclosed K hK)
        (ENNReal.lt_add_right (measure_ne_top ν K) (by simpa using hε))
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt hlt] with n hn
    have h1 : (μ n K).toReal ≤ (ν K + ENNReal.ofReal ε).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨measure_ne_top ν K, ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top⟩)
        hn.le
    simpa [ENNReal.toReal_add (measure_ne_top ν K) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hε.le] using h1
  have hmass : Tendsto (fun n => (μ n Set.univ).toReal) atTop (𝓝 (ν Set.univ).toReal) := by
    simpa [Measure.real] using h 1
  have hsplit : ∀ (m : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure m] (s : Set X), MeasurableSet s →
      (m s).toReal + (m sᶜ).toReal = (m Set.univ).toReal := fun m _ s hs => by
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_add (measure_ne_top m s) (measure_ne_top m sᶜ),
      measure_add_measure_compl hs]
  have hcl : ν (closure A) = ν A := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · calc ν (closure A) ≤ ν (A ∪ frontier A) := measure_mono (fun x hx => by
            by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
            · exact Or.inl hxA
            · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, fun hi => hxA (interior_subset hi)⟩)
        _ ≤ ν A + ν (frontier A) := measure_union_le _ _
        _ = ν A := by rw [hA, add_zero]
    · exact measure_mono subset_closure
  have hint : ν (interior A) = ν A := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact measure_mono interior_subset
    · calc ν A ≤ ν (interior A ∪ frontier A) := measure_mono (fun x hx => by
            by_cases hxi : x ∈ interior A
            · exact Or.inl hxi
            · exact Or.inr ⟨subset_closure hx, hxi⟩)
        _ ≤ ν (interior A) + ν (frontier A) := measure_union_le _ _
        _ = ν (interior A) := by rw [hA, add_zero]
  have hF₂ : IsClosed (interior A)ᶜ := isOpen_interior.isClosed_compl
  have hreal : Tendsto (fun n => (μ n A).toReal) atTop (𝓝 (ν A).toReal) := by
    rw [tendsto_order]
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      set δ := ((ν A).toReal - a) / 3 with hδ
      have hδpos : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; linarith
      have e1 := upper (interior A)ᶜ hF₂ δ hδpos
      have e2 : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (ν Set.univ).toReal - δ < (μ n Set.univ).toReal :=
        (tendsto_order.1 hmass).1 _ (by linarith)
      filter_upwards [e1, e2] with n hn1 hn2
      have s1 := hsplit (μ n) (interior A) isOpen_interior.measurableSet
      have s2 := hsplit ν (interior A) isOpen_interior.measurableSet
      have hmono : (μ n (interior A)).toReal ≤ (μ n A).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_mono interior_subset)
      have hνi : (ν (interior A)).toReal = (ν A).toReal := by rw [hint]
      linarith
    · intro b hb
      set δ := (b - (ν A).toReal) / 2 with hδ
      have hδpos : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; linarith
      have e1 := upper (closure A) isClosed_closure δ hδpos
      filter_upwards [e1] with n hn1
      have hmono : (μ n A).toReal ≤ (μ n (closure A)).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_mono subset_closure)
      have hνc : (ν (closure A)).toReal = (ν A).toReal := by rw [hcl]
      linarith
  exact (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal_iff (fun n => measure_ne_top _ _) (measure_ne_top _ _)).mp hreal

theorem exists_measure_of_posLinear [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    (Λ : C(X, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hΛ : ∀ f : C(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ f → 0 ≤ Λ f) :
    ∃ μ : Measure X, IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ ∀ f : C(X, ℝ), ∫ x, f x ∂μ = Λ f

  (∀ (f : ContinuousMap X Real), ContinuousMap.partialOrder.le 0 f → Real.instLE.le 0 (LinearMap.instFunLike.coe Λ f)) →
    Exists fun μ =>

  let toC : C(X, ℝ) → C_c(X, ℝ) := fun f => ⟨f, HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace f⟩
  let Λ' : C_c(X, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=

        rw [RingHom.id_apply, ← map_smul]; rfl }
  have hΛ' : ∀ g : C_c(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ g → 0 ≤ Λ' g := fun g hg => hΛ g.toContinuousMap hg

        map_add' := fun g h => by

        map_smul' := fun c g => by
          rw [RingHom.id_apply, ← map_smul]; rfl }
      (fun g hg => hΛ g.toContinuousMap hg)
  refine ⟨RealRMK.rieszMeasure Λ', ?_, fun f => ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨?_⟩
    have h := RealRMK.rieszMeasure_le_of_eq_one Λ' (f := toC 1) (fun x => zero_le_one)

  · have := RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure Λ' (toC f)
    exact this

    (varying_J : VaryingAlmostComplexStructures I (M := M))

    (u_lim : StableSphereTreeLimit I (M := M))
    (h_prin_gap : ∀ v : u_lim.tree.V, is_principal_component I u_lim v →

theorem satisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann_const
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 < p) (k : ℕ) (r R : ℝ) (hrR : 0 < r ∧ r < R) (c : ℂ) :
    SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann p k r R (fun _ => c)
goal_type:
∀ (p : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 1 p →
    ∀ (k : Nat) (r R : Real),
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 r) (Real.instLT.lt r R) →
        ∀ (c : Complex), GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann p k r R fun x => c
proof:
by
  dsimp [SatisfiesSobolevCauchyRiemann]
  have h_base := constant_map_cauchy_riemann_estimate p hp k r R hrR c
  have hp1 : 0 < p - 1 := sub_pos.mpr hp
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := lt_trans hrR.1 hrR.2
  have hSub_pos : 0 < R - r := sub_pos.mpr hrR.2
  have h_extra : 0 ≤ p / (p - 1) * (R / (R - r)) ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
  have h_rhs_nonneg : 0 ≤ sobolevNorm p k (cauchyRiemann (fun _ => c)) (Metric.closedBall 0 R) +
      sobolevNorm p 0 (fun _ => c) (Metric.closedBall 0 R) := by
    apply add_nonneg
    · exact sobolevNorm_nonneg p k _ _ measurableSet_closedBall
    · exact sobolevNorm_nonneg p 0 _ _ measurableSet_closedBall
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h_extra h_rhs_nonneg]

lemma OneLevelDecomposition.ghost_outside_unit_disk_mass
    (thresh : TargetThresholds I M) (m_defect : ℝ) (base_val : M)
    (decomp : OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val)
    (h_const_en : totalEnergy I decomp.v = 0)
    (h_const_disk : energyMeasure I decomp.v (disk_at 0 1) = 0) :
    (∑ z ∈ decomp.q.filter (fun w => ¬ (‖w‖ < 1)), decomp.m_child z) = thresh.h / 2
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (thresh : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (m_defect : Real) (base_val : M)
  (decomp : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.OneLevelDecomposition I thresh m_defect base_val),
  Eq (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I decomp.v) 0 →
    Eq (GromovCompactness.energyMeasure I decomp.v (GromovCompactness.disk_at 0 1)) 0 →
      Eq
        ((Finset.filter (fun w => Not (Real.instLT.lt (Complex.instNorm.norm w) 1)) decomp.q).sum fun z =>
          decomp.m_child z)
        (instHDiv.hDiv thresh.h 2)
proof:
by
  let q_in := decomp.q.filter (fun w => ‖w‖ < 1)
  let q_out := decomp.q.filter (fun w => ¬ (‖w‖ < 1))
  have h_split : decomp.q = q_in ∪ q_out := by
    ext z
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      by_cases h : ‖z‖ < 1
      · left; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
      · right; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
    · rintro (⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hz, _⟩)
      · exact hz
      · exact hz
  have h_disj : Disjoint q_in q_out := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro x _ hx_in hx_out
    exact hx_out hx_in
  have h_sum_split : (∑ z ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child z) =
      (∑ z ∈ q_in, decomp.m_child z) + (∑ z ∈ q_out, decomp.m_child z) := by
    rw [h_split, Finset.sum_union h_disj]
  have h_in_sum : (∑ z ∈ q_in, decomp.m_child z) = m_defect - thresh.h / 2 := by
    have h_calib := decomp.calibrated_unit_mass
    rw [h_const_disk, zero_add] at h_calib
    exact h_calib
  have h_tot_sum : (∑ z ∈ decomp.q, decomp.m_child z) = m_defect := by
    have h_ms := decomp.mass_sum
    rw [h_const_en, zero_add] at h_ms
    exact h_ms.symm
  linarith [h_sum_split, h_in_sum, h_tot_sum]

name: ghost_component_pure_automorphism_trivial
docstring:
On any ghost component with degree ≥ 3, any pure automorphism fixing the tree structure
must act as the identity on that component, given 3-point Möbius rigidity of frames on CP1.
signature:
theorem ghost_component_pure_automorphism_trivial
    (lim : StableSphereTreeLimit I (M := M))
    (v : lim.tree.V)
    (h_ghost : is_ghost_component I lim v)
    (aut : PureComponentAutomorphism I lim)
    (h_rigidity : ∀ (ϕ : MoebiusFrame) (p₁ p₂ p₃ : CP1),
      p₁ ≠ p₂ → p₁ ≠ p₃ → p₂ ≠ p₃ →
      ϕ.toHomeo p₁ = p₁ → ϕ.toHomeo p₂ = p₂ → ϕ.toHomeo p₃ = p₃ →
      ϕ.toHomeo = Homeomorph.refl CP1) :
    (aut.1.frame v).toHomeo = Homeomorph.refl CP1
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (v : lim.tree.V),
  GromovCompactness.is_ghost_component I lim v →
    ∀ (aut : GromovCompactness.Extensions.PureComponentAutomorphism I lim),
      (∀ (ϕ : GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame) (p₁ p₂ p₃ : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
          Ne p₁ p₂ →
            Ne p₁ p₃ →
              Ne p₂ p₃ →
                Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ.toHomeo p₁) p₁ →
                  Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ.toHomeo p₂) p₂ →
                    Eq (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe ϕ.toHomeo p₃) p₃ →
                      Eq ϕ.toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)) →
        Eq (aut.val.frame v).toHomeo (Homeomorph.refl GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem)
proof:
by
  have h_stab : 3 ≤ lim.tree.adj.degree v := lim.stable v h_ghost
  have h_card : 3 ≤ (lim.tree.adj.neighborFinset v).card := by
    rw [SimpleGraph.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree]
    exact h_stab
  have h_nonempty : (lim.tree.adj.neighborFinset v).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro he
    rw [he, Finset.card_empty] at h_card
    omega
  obtain ⟨w₁, hw1_mem⟩ := h_nonempty
  have h_card1 : 2 ≤ ((lim.tree.adj.neighborFinset v).erase w₁).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hw1_mem]
    omega
  have h_nonempty1 : ((lim.tree.adj.neighborFinset v).erase w₁).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro he
    rw [he, Finset.card_empty] at h_card1
    omega
  obtain ⟨w₂, hw2_mem'⟩ := h_nonempty1
  have hw2_mem := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw2_mem'
  have hw12_ne : w₁ ≠ w₂ := (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hw2_mem').symm
  have h_card2 : 1 ≤ (((lim.tree.adj.neighborFinset v).erase w₁).erase w₂).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hw2_mem']
    omega
  have h_nonempty2 : (((lim.tree.adj.neighborFinset v).erase w₁).erase w₂).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro he
    rw [he, Finset.card_empty] at h_card2
    omega
  obtain ⟨w₃, hw3_mem''⟩ := h_nonempty2
  have hw3_mem' := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw3_mem''
  have hw23_ne : w₂ ≠ w₃ := (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hw3_mem'').symm
  have hw3_mem := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hw3_mem'
  have hw13_ne : w₁ ≠ w₃ := (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hw3_mem').symm

  have h_adj1 : lim.tree.adj.Adj v w₁ := by rwa [lim.tree.adj.mem_neighborFinset] at hw1_mem
  have h_adj2 : lim.tree.adj.Adj v w₂ := by rwa [lim.tree.adj.mem_neighborFinset] at hw2_mem
  have h_adj3 : lim.tree.adj.Adj v w₃ := by rwa [lim.tree.adj.mem_neighborFinset] at hw3_mem

  let p₁ := lim.tree.node_point v w₁ h_adj1
  let p₂ := lim.tree.node_point v w₂ h_adj2
  let p₃ := lim.tree.node_point v w₃ h_adj3

  have hp12 : p₁ ≠ p₂ := lim.tree.node_distinct v w₁ w₂ h_adj1 h_adj2 hw12_ne
  have hp13 : p₁ ≠ p₃ := lim.tree.node_distinct v w₁ w₃ h_adj1 h_adj3 hw13_ne
  have hp23 : p₂ ≠ p₃ := lim.tree.node_distinct v w₂ w₃ h_adj2 h_adj3 hw23_ne

  have h_fix1 : (aut.1.frame v).toHomeo p₁ = p₁ := pure_automorphism_fixes_nodes I lim aut v w₁ h_adj1
  have h_fix2 : (aut.1.frame v).toHomeo p₂ = p₂ := pure_automorphism_fixes_nodes I lim aut v w₂ h_adj2
  have h_fix3 : (aut.1.frame v).toHomeo p₃ = p₃ := pure_automorphism_fixes_nodes I lim aut v w₃ h_adj3

  exact h_rigidity (aut.1.frame v) p₁ p₂ p₃ hp12 hp13 hp23 h_fix1 h_fix2 h_fix3

    (m : CP1 → ℝ) (hm_pos : ∀ p ∈ cdata.S, 0 ≤ m p)
    (h_decomp : cdata.μ = energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, (ENNReal.ofReal (m p) • Measure.dirac p)) :

lemma sphericalJacobian_lower_bound (w₀ : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ j_min : ℝ, 0 < j_min ∧ ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r, j_min ≤ sphericalJacobian w

∀ (w₀ : Complex) (r : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Exists fun j_min =>
      And (Real.instLT.lt 0 j_min)
        (∀ (w : Complex),
          Set.instMembership.mem (Metric.ball w₀ r) w → Real.instLE.le j_min (GromovCompactness.sphericalJacobian w))
proof:
by
  have h_bound : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball w₀ r, ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w₀‖ + r := by
    intro w hw
    have hdist : dist w w₀ < r := Metric.mem_ball.mp hw
    calc ‖w‖ = ‖w₀ + (w - w₀)‖ := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ ‖w₀‖ + ‖w - w₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖w₀‖ + dist w w₀ := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ ‖w₀‖ + r := by linarith
  set R := ‖w₀‖ + r
  set j_min := (2 / (1 + R^2))^2
  refine ⟨j_min, ?_, ?_⟩
  · positivity
  · intro w hw
    dsimp [sphericalJacobian, j_min]
    have hw_norm := h_bound w hw
    have h_nonneg1 : 0 ≤ 2 / (1 + R^2) := by positivity
    gcongr

name: exp_decay_bound_of_diff_ineq
docstring:
Exponential decay bound $F(T) \le F(L) \cdot e^{-(L - T)/c}$:
Integrating the differential inequality $F(t) \le c \cdot F'(t)$ gives exponential decay
with rate $1/c$ from the boundary collar $L$ down to $T$.
signature:
lemma exp_decay_bound_of_diff_ineq {F : ℝ → ℝ} (hF : Differentiable ℝ F)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (h_ineq : ∀ t, F t ≤ c * deriv F t)
    {T L : ℝ} (hTL : T ≤ L) :
    F T ≤ F L * Real.exp (-(L - T) / c)
goal_type:
∀ {F : Real → Real},
  Differentiable Real F →
    ∀ {c : Real},
      Real.instLT.lt 0 c →
        (∀ (t : Real), Real.instLE.le (F t) (instHMul.hMul c (deriv F t))) →
          ∀ {T L : Real},
            Real.instLE.le T L →
              Real.instLE.le (F T)
                (instHMul.hMul (F L) (Real.exp (instHDiv.hDiv (Real.instNeg.neg (instHSub.hSub L T)) c)))
proof:
by
  have h := exp_decay_of_diff_ineq hF hc h_ineq hTL
  have h_exp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (T / c) := Real.exp_pos _
  have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h h_exp_pos.le
  have h_id1 : (F T * Real.exp (-T / c)) * Real.exp (T / c) = F T := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    have : -T / c + T / c = 0 := by ring
    rw [this, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have h_id2 : (F L * Real.exp (-L / c)) * Real.exp (T / c) = F L * Real.exp (-(L - T) / c) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  rw [h_id1, h_id2] at h_mul
  exact h_mul

    {δ ρ α : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ)

  calc δ / ρ = (δ ^ α * δ ^ (1 - α)) / ρ := by rw [← hδ_split]

name: card_V_add_two_le_of_all_const
docstring: If every component of a `k`-marked stable sphere tree limit `u_lim` is constant, then `|V| + 2 ≤ k` (`0 unproved`).
signature:
theorem MarkedStableTreeLimit.card_V_add_two_le_of_all_const {k : ℕ}
    (u_lim : MarkedStableTreeLimit I (M := M) k)
    (h_const : ∀ v : u_lim.tree.V, ∃ c : M, ∀ z : CP1, u_lim.map v z = c) :
    Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V + 2 ≤ k
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat}
  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedStableTreeLimit I k),
  (∀ (v : u_lim.tree.V), Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (u_lim.map v z) c) →
    instLENat.le (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V) 2) k
proof:
by
  have h_le : ∑ _v : u_lim.tree.V, (3 : ℕ) ≤
      ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, (u_lim.tree.adj.degree v + Fintype.card { i : Fin k // u_lim.mark_vertex i = v }) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v _ => u_lim.stable v (h_const v))
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h_le
  have h_lhs : (∑ _v : u_lim.tree.V, (3 : ℕ)) = 3 * Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have h_deg := tree_degree_sum u_lim.tree
  have h_fib : (∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, Fintype.card { i : Fin k // u_lim.mark_vertex i = v }) = k := by
    have h_equiv := Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv u_lim.mark_vertex)
    rw [Fintype.card_sigma, Fintype.card_fin] at h_equiv
    exact h_equiv
  have h_pos : 0 < Fintype.card u_lim.tree.V := Fintype.card_pos
  omega

theorem prune_degree_one_root_of_singleton_conv

    (pdata : PrestableLimitData I u_seq)

    (h_const : ∃ c : M, ∀ z, pdata.map pdata.root z = c)
    (h_pt : ∀ (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
      SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
        (fun n => (u_seq (pdata.σ.1 n)) ∘ (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo)
        (pdata.map w₀)
        {pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root (pdata.tree.adj.adj_symm hw₀_adj)}) :
    ∃ (pdata' : PrestableLimitData I u_seq),
      Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V + 1 = Fintype.card pdata.tree.V ∧
      (∑ v : pdata'.tree.V, totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v)) =
        (∑ v : pdata.tree.V, totalEnergy I (pdata.map v))

  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

  Eq (pdata.tree.adj.degree pdata.root) 1 →
    (Exists fun c => ∀ (z : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Eq (pdata.map pdata.root z) c) →
      (∀ (w₀ : pdata.tree.V) (hw₀_adj : pdata.tree.adj.Adj pdata.root w₀),
          GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (pdata.σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (pdata.frames w₀ n).toHomeo))
            (pdata.map w₀) (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton (pdata.tree.node_point w₀ pdata.root ⋯))) →
        Exists fun pdata' =>
          And (Eq (instHAdd.hAdd (Fintype.card pdata'.tree.V) 1) (Fintype.card pdata.tree.V))
            (Eq (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata'.map v))
              (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (pdata.map v)))

  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀_adj, hw₀_uniq⟩ := root_degree_one_neighbor pdata.tree pdata.root h_deg1
  have hw₀_ne : w₀ ≠ pdata.root := hw₀_adj.ne'
  let root' : { v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root } := ⟨w₀, hw₀_ne⟩
  haveI : Nonempty { v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root } := ⟨root'⟩
  obtain ⟨frames', h_root_id, h_collapse, h_smooth⟩ :=
    pruned_tree_frames_and_conv_of_singleton_conv I u_seq pdata root' hw₀_adj hw₀_uniq (h_pt w₀ hw₀_adj)
  have h_sum_eq : (∑ v : {v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root}, totalEnergy I (pdata.map v.1)) =
      ∑ v : pdata.tree.V, totalEnergy I (pdata.map v) :=
    sum_subtype_ne_root_eq_sum_univ_of_zero pdata.root
      (fun v => totalEnergy I (pdata.map v))
      (totalEnergy_root_eq_zero_of_const I u_seq pdata h_const)
  let tree' : SphereTree := {
    V := { v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root }
    adj := prunedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root
    is_tree := prunedSimpleGraph_isTree pdata.tree pdata.root h_deg1
    node_point := fun u v h => pdata.tree.node_point u.1 v.1 h
    node_distinct := fun u w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ hne =>
      pdata.tree.node_distinct u.1 w₁.1 w₂.1 h₁ h₂ (fun heq => hne (Subtype.ext heq))
  }
  let pdata' : PrestableLimitData I u_seq := {
    tree := tree'
    root := root'
    map := fun v => pdata.map v.1
    is_jhol := fun v => pdata.is_jhol v.1
    nodal_match := fun u v h => pdata.nodal_match u.1 v.1 h
    stable_off_root := fun v hv h_const_v => by
      have hv_ne_w0 : v.1 ≠ w₀ := fun h_eq => hv (Subtype.ext h_eq)
      change 3 ≤ (prunedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root).degree v
      rw [prunedSimpleGraph_degree_eq_of_ne pdata.tree pdata.root w₀ hw₀_uniq v hv_ne_w0]
      exact pdata.stable_off_root v.1 v.2 h_const_v
    σ := pdata.σ
    frames := frames'
    root_frame_id := h_root_id
    frame_collapse := h_collapse
    smooth_conv := h_smooth
    ghost_root_deg_one_conv := fun h_deg1' h_const' => by
      have h_ge3 := pdata.stable_off_root w₀ hw₀_ne h_const'
      have h_add := prunedSimpleGraph_degree_neighbor_add_one pdata.tree pdata.root w₀ hw₀_adj
      change (prunedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root).degree ⟨w₀, hw₀_adj.ne'⟩ = 1 at h_deg1'
      omega
    energy_ident := by
      change Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (pdata.σ.1 n))) atTop
        (𝓝 (∑ v : {v : pdata.tree.V // v ≠ pdata.root}, totalEnergy I (pdata.map v.1)))
      rw [h_sum_eq]
      exact pdata.energy_ident
  }
  exact ⟨pdata', card_subtype_ne_root_add_one pdata.root, h_sum_eq⟩

lemma ProjEquiv.trans {p q r : ℂ × ℂ} (hq : q ≠ (0, 0)) (hpq : ProjEquiv p q) (hqr : ProjEquiv q r) :
    ProjEquiv p r
goal_type:
∀ {p q r : Prod Complex Complex},
  Ne q { fst := 0, snd := 0 } →
    GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv p q → GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv q r → GromovCompactness.ProjEquiv p r
proof:
by
  dsimp [ProjEquiv] at *
  by_cases hq1 : q.1 = 0
  · have hq2 : q.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; exact hq (Prod.ext hq1 h)
    have hp1 : p.1 = 0 := by
      have : p.1 * q.2 = 0 := by rw [hpq, hq1, mul_zero]
      exact mul_eq_zero.mp this |>.resolve_right hq2
    have hr1 : r.1 = 0 := by
      have : r.1 * q.2 = 0 := by
        calc r.1 * q.2 = q.2 * r.1 := mul_comm _ _
        _ = q.1 * r.2 := hqr.symm
        _ = 0 * r.2 := by rw [hq1]
        _ = 0 := zero_mul _
      exact mul_eq_zero.mp this |>.resolve_right hq2
    rw [hp1, hr1]
    ring
  · have : p.1 * r.2 * q.1 = p.2 * r.1 * q.1 := by
      calc p.1 * r.2 * q.1 = (p.1 * q.1) * r.2 := by ring
      _ = (p.1 * q.2) * r.1 := by
        have : q.1 * r.2 = q.2 * r.1 := hqr
        linear_combination p.1 * this
      _ = (p.2 * q.1) * r.1 := by rw [hpq]
      _ = p.2 * r.1 * q.1 := by ring
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hq1 this

    {ε C B η : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hC : 0 < C) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ∀ e : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ δ : ℝ,
      Antitone e → (∀ k, 0 ≤ e k) → e 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ j, e j - e (j + 1) < ε → e (j + 1) ≤ C * (e j - e (j + 1)) + δ) →
      e N ≤ η + δ

  Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
    Real.instLT.lt 0 C →
      Real.instLE.le 0 B →
        Real.instLT.lt 0 η →

            And (instLTNat.lt 0 N)
              (∀ (e : Nat → Real) (δ : Real),
                Antitone e →
                  (∀ (k : Nat), Real.instLE.le 0 (e k)) →
                    Real.instLE.le (e 0) B →
                      (∀ (j : Nat),
                          Real.instLT.lt (instHSub.hSub (e j) (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))) ε →
                            Real.instLE.le (e (instHAdd.hAdd j 1))

    have hNreal : (0 : ℝ) < N := (div_nonneg hB ht.le).trans_lt hN

  refine ⟨N, hNpos, ?_⟩
  intro e δ he hnonneg hzero hdrop
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjdrop⟩ := exists_sub_lt_of_mul_lt e (hnonneg N) hzero hBmul
  have hsmall : e j - e (j + 1) < ε := hjdrop.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)

  (u_lim : GromovCompactness.StableSphereTreeLimit I) (B : Real),
  Real.instLE.le (Finset.univ.sum fun v => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v)) B →
    have P := Fintype.card (Subtype fun v => GromovCompactness.is_principal_component I u_lim v);

  let s_prin := Finset.univ.filter (is_principal_component I u_lim)
  have hP : P = s_prin.card := by
    dsimp [P, s_prin]
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
  have h_each : ∀ v ∈ s_prin, th.h ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv_prin : is_principal_component I u_lim v := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hv_nonconst : ¬ ∃ c : M, ∀ z : CP1, u_lim.map v z = c := hv_prin
    have h_sph := th.h_sph (u_lim.map v) (u_lim.is_jhol v) hv_nonconst
    exact th.h_le_sph.trans h_sph
  have h_sum_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, th.h ≤ ∑ v ∈ s_prin, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum h_each
  have h_const_sum : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, th.h = (P : ℝ) * th.h := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hP]
  rw [h_const_sum] at h_sum_le
  have h_nonneg : ∀ v : u_lim.tree.V, 0 ≤ totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    intro v
    exact energy_nonneg I (u_lim.map v) Set.univ
  have h_sub_le : ∑ v ∈ s_prin, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) ≤
      ∑ v : u_lim.tree.V, totalEnergy I (u_lim.map v) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg
    intro i
    exact h_nonneg i
  exact h_sum_le.trans (h_sub_le.trans h_energy)

lemma suppressed_walk_bridge_parity (tree : SphereTree) (root : tree.V)
    (w₁ w₂ : { v : tree.V // v ≠ root })
    (hne : w₁ ≠ w₂)
    (hadj₁ : tree.adj.Adj root w₁.1)
    (hadj₂ : tree.adj.Adj root w₂.1)
    {x y : { v : tree.V // v ≠ root }}
    (p : (suppressedSimpleGraph tree root w₁.1 w₂.1).Walk x y) :
    (p.edges.count s(w₁, w₂) : ZMod 2) =
    if inCompW1 tree root w₁ x = inCompW1 tree root w₁ y then 0 else 1
goal_type:
∀ (tree : GromovCompactness.SphereTree) (root : tree.V) (w₁ w₂ : Subtype fun v => Ne v root),
  Ne w₁ w₂ →
    tree.adj.Adj root w₁.val →
      tree.adj.Adj root w₂.val →
        ∀ {x y : Subtype fun v => Ne v root}
          (p : (GromovCompactness.Assembly.suppressedSimpleGraph tree root w₁.val w₂.val).Walk x y),
          Eq (List.count (Sym2.mk w₁ w₂) p.edges).cast
            (ite
              (Eq (GromovCompactness.Assembly.inCompW1 tree root w₁ x)
                (GromovCompactness.Assembly.inCompW1 tree root w₁ y))
              0 1)
proof:
by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons u v z h q ih =>
    rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.edges_cons, List.count_cons]
    have h_step := inCompW1_step tree root w₁ w₂ hne hadj₁ hadj₂ h
    push_cast
    rw [ih]
    by_cases he : s(u, v) = s(w₁, w₂)
    · simp only [he, beq_self_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      have h_diff : inCompW1 tree root w₁ u ≠ inCompW1 tree root w₁ v := h_step.mpr he
      rcases hu : inCompW1 tree root w₁ u <;> rcases hv : inCompW1 tree root w₁ v <;>
        rcases hz : inCompW1 tree root w₁ z <;>
        simp_all <;> try decide
    · have h_beq : (s(u, v) == s(w₁, w₂)) = false := by
        simp [beq_iff_eq, he]
      simp only [h_beq, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
      have h_same : inCompW1 tree root w₁ u = inCompW1 tree root w₁ v := by
        by_contra h_diff
        exact he (h_step.mp h_diff)
      rw [h_same]

  have h_mf : ((M₁.mul F).act (F.adj.act p)).1 * ((M₂.mul F).act (F.adj.act p)).2 -

Marked Gromov compactness when `3 ≤ k`, `B < th.ε_sph`, and a subsequence has fixed `north_pole`
value and converging distinct marked points (`0 unproved`).
signature:
theorem marked_gromov_compactness_of_lt_eps_sph_of_marks_conv {k : ℕ}
    (th : Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
    (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (u_seq : ℕ → MarkedSphere M k) (B : ℝ)
    (h_jhol : ∀ n, JHolomorphicOn I I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ)
    (h_energy : ∀ n, totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map ≤ B)
    (h_lt : B < th.ε_sph)
    (σ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (c₀ : M)
    (hc₀ : ∀ n, (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map north_pole = c₀)
    (pts : Fin k → CP1)
    (h_pts_dist : ∀ (i j : Fin k), i ≠ j → pts i ≠ pts j)
    (h_marks : ∀ i : Fin k, Tendsto (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)).points i) atTop (𝓝 (pts i))) :
    ∃ (u_lim : MarkedStableTreeLimit I (M := M) k)
      (_wit : MarkedCompactnessWitness I u_seq u_lim),
      markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim ≤ B
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] {k : Nat} (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M),
  instLENat.le 3 k →
    ∀ (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.Extensions.MarkedSphere M k) (B : Real),
      (∀ (n : Nat), GromovCompactness.JHolomorphicOn I GromovCompactness.I_CP1 (u_seq n).map Set.univ) →
        (∀ (n : Nat), Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq n).map) B) →
          Real.instLT.lt B th.ε_sph →
            ∀ (σ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (c₀ : M),
              (∀ (n : Nat), Eq ((u_seq (σ.val n)).map GromovCompactness.north_pole) c₀) →
                ∀ (pts : Fin k → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),
                  (∀ (i j : Fin k), Ne i j → Ne (pts i) (pts j)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (u_seq (σ.val n)).points i) Filter.atTop (nhds (pts i))) →
                      Exists fun u_lim =>
                        Exists fun _wit => Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.Extensions.markedTreeTotalEnergy I u_lim) B
proof:
by
  let u₀ : MarkedSphere M k := ⟨fun _ => c₀, pts, h_pts_dist⟩
  have h_eq : (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map) = fun _ _ => c₀ := by
    ext n z
    have h_const_n := Compactness.eq_const_north_pole_of_jhol_of_totalEnergy_lt_eps_sph I th
      (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map (h_jhol (σ.1 n)) ((h_energy (σ.1 n)).trans_lt h_lt)
    calc (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map z = (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map north_pole := congr_fun h_const_n z
      _ = c₀ := hc₀ n
  have h_conv : SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map) u₀.map Set.univ := by
    change SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map) (fun _ => c₀) Set.univ
    rw [h_eq]
    exact smoothLocalConvergesOn_const_map I c₀ Set.univ
  have h_en : Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map) atTop (𝓝 (totalEnergy I u₀.map)) := by
    have h_en_eq : (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map) =
        fun _ => totalEnergy I (fun _ : CP1 => c₀) := by
      ext n
      exact congrArg (totalEnergy I) (congr_fun h_eq n)
    change Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n)).map) atTop (𝓝 (totalEnergy I (fun _ => c₀)))
    rw [h_en_eq]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  exact marked_gromov_compactness_of_no_bubble I u_seq B h_energy
    ⟨σ, u₀, Analysis.jholomorphicOn_const I c₀ Set.univ, fun _ => hk, h_conv, h_marks, h_en⟩

      cdata.μ = energyMeasureExtended I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, (ENNReal.ofReal (m p) • Measure.dirac p) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n))) atTop
        (nhds (totalEnergy I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, m p))

      (Exists fun N₀ =>
          ∀ (n : Nat), GE.ge n N₀ → Real.instLE.le (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) 0) →

          And
            (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),

            (And (∀ (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem), Not (SetLike.instMembership.mem cdata.S p) → Eq (m p) 0)

                    (cdata.S.sum fun p => instHSMul.hSMul (ENNReal.ofReal (m p)) (MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac p))))
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (cdata.σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m p))))))

theorem atom_iff_concentration (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (x : X) (ε₀ : ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ μ {x} ↔ ∀ r > 0, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ μ (closedBall x r)
goal_type:
∀ {X : Type u_4} [inst : MetricSpace X] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (x : X) (ε₀ : Real),
  Iff
    (ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀) (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Set.instSingletonSet.singleton x)))
    (∀ (r : Real),
      GT.gt r 0 →
        ENNReal.instLE.le (ENNReal.ofReal ε₀) (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ (Metric.closedBall x r)))
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h r hr
    have h_sub : ({x} : Set X) ⊆ closedBall x r := by
      rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff, mem_closedBall, dist_self]
      exact hr.le
    exact le_trans h (measure_mono h_sub)
  · intro h
    have h_seq : ∀ n : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ε₀ ≤ μ (closedBall x (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) := by
      intro n
      apply h
      positivity
    have h_lim := tendsto_measure_closedBall_inv_succ μ x
    exact ge_of_tendsto h_lim (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_seq)

    (u : CP1 → M) (p : CP1) :
    energyMeasureExtended I u {p} = 0

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M)
  (p : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),

theorem norm_iteratedFDeriv_sub_le_sSup_succ_of_contDiffOn

  exact le_csSup (bddAbove_norm_iteratedFDeriv_ball_of_contDiffOn (m + 1) hR hg) ⟨ζ, hζ, rfl⟩

name: D_val_pos
docstring: The denominator $D_\lambda(t)$ is strictly positive for all $t \in [-1, 1]$ whenever $\lambda > 0$.
signature:
theorem D_val_pos (l : ℝ) (hl : 0 < l) (t : ℝ) (ht1 : -1 ≤ t) (ht2 : t ≤ 1) :
    0 < D_val l t
goal_type:
∀ (l : Real),
  Real.instLT.lt 0 l →
    ∀ (t : Real), Real.instLE.le (-1) t → Real.instLE.le t 1 → Real.instLT.lt 0 (GromovCompactness.D_val l t)
proof:
by
  dsimp [D_val]
  have h_dec : (1 + l^2) + (1 - l^2) * t = (1 - t) * l^2 + (1 + t) := by ring
  rw [h_dec]
  by_cases h : t = -1
  · subst h
    have : (1 - -1 : ℝ) * l^2 + (1 + -1) = 2 * l^2 := by ring
    rw [this]
    positivity
  · have ht_lt : -1 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne ht1 (Ne.symm h)
    have h1 : 0 < 1 + t := by linarith
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 - t) * l^2 := by
      have : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith
      positivity
    linarith

name: cauchyRiemann_differenceQuotient
docstring:
Finite difference quotients commute with the Cauchy-Riemann operator:
$\bar\partial(\Delta_{h, v} f)(z) = \Delta_{h, v}(\bar\partial f)(z)$.
signature:
theorem cauchyRiemann_differenceQuotient (f : ℂ → ℂ) (v : ℂ) (h : ℝ) (z : ℂ)
    (hf_z : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z)
    (hf_zh : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (z + (h : ℂ) * v)) :
    cauchyRiemann (fun w => differenceQuotient f v h w) z =
      differenceQuotient (cauchyRiemann f) v h z
goal_type:
∀ (f : Complex → Complex) (v : Complex) (h : Real) (z : Complex),
  DifferentiableAt Real f z →
    DifferentiableAt Real f (instHAdd.hAdd z (instHMul.hMul (Complex.ofReal h) v)) →
      Eq (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann (fun w => GromovCompactness.Analysis.differenceQuotient f v h w) z)
        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.differenceQuotient (GromovCompactness.Analysis.cauchyRiemann f) v h z)
proof:
by
  dsimp [differenceQuotient]
  let a : ℂ := (h : ℂ) * v
  have h_trans_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f (w + a)) z := by
    have h_comp : (fun w => f (w + a)) = f ∘ (fun w => w + a) := rfl
    rw [h_comp]
    apply DifferentiableAt.comp z hf_zh
    exact differentiableAt_id.add_const a
  have h_sub_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f (w + a) - f w) z :=
    h_trans_diff.sub hf_z
  have h1 := cauchyRiemann_const_mul (1 / (h : ℂ)) (fun w => f (w + a) - f w) z h_sub_diff
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : cauchyRiemann (fun w => f (w + a) - f w) z =
            cauchyRiemann (fun w => f (w + a)) z - cauchyRiemann f z := by
    exact cauchyRiemann_sub (fun w => f (w + a)) f z h_trans_diff hf_z
  rw [h2]
  rw [cauchyRiemann_translate f a z hf_zh]

name: metric_pos_def
docstring:
Positive-definiteness of the symmetrized metric, directly implied by tameness:
$g(v, v) = \omega(v, Jv) > 0$ for $v \neq 0$.
signature:
theorem metric_pos_def [tgt : ClosedTameTarget I M] (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < ClosedTameTarget.metric I x v v
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [tgt : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (x : M) (v : TangentSpace I x),
  Ne v 0 → Real.instLT.lt 0 (GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget.metric I x v v)
proof:
by
  dsimp [ClosedTameTarget.metric]
  have h_tame := tgt.tame x v hv
  -- Since g(v, v) = 1/2 * (ω(v, Jv) + ω(v, Jv)) = ω(v, Jv), positivity follows from tameness.
  have h_eq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (tgt.«ω» x v (tgt.J x v) + tgt.«ω» x v (tgt.J x v)) = tgt.«ω» x v (tgt.J x v) := by ring
  rw [h_eq]
  exact h_tame

lemma ckHolderNorm_mono_order {j k : ℕ} (hjk : j ≤ k) (α : ℝ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (s : Set ℂ) :
    sSup ((fun z => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f z‖) '' s) ≤ ckHolderNorm k α f s
goal_type:
∀ {j k : Nat},
  instLENat.le j k →
    ∀ (α : Real) (f : Complex → Complex) (s : Set Complex),
      Real.instLE.le
        (Real.instSupSet.sSup
          (Set.image (fun z => ContinuousMultilinearMap.hasOpNorm'.norm (iteratedFDeriv Real j f z)) s))
        (GromovCompactness.Analysis.ckHolderNorm k α f s)
proof:
by
  dsimp [ckHolderNorm]
  have h_in : j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hjk)
  have h_split := Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem h_in (fun i => sSup ((fun z => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f z‖) '' s))
  rw [h_split]
  have h_rem_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) \ {j}, sSup ((fun z => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ x f z‖) '' s) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    apply sSup_nonneg_of_forall_nonneg
    rintro y ⟨z, _, rfl⟩
    exact norm_nonneg _
  have h_deriv_nonneg := derivHolderSeminorm_nonneg k α f s
  linarith

lemma frontier_disk_at_subset_circle_at (a : ℂ) (r : ℝ) :
    frontier (disk_at a r) ⊆ circle_at a r
goal_type: ∀ (a : Complex) (r : Real), Set.instLE.le (frontier (GromovCompactness.disk_at a r)) (GromovCompactness.circle_at a r)
proof:
by
  have h_open : IsOpen (disk_at a r) := is_open_disk_at a r
  have h_closed_cb : IsClosed (stereo_chart.symm '' Metric.closedBall a r) :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall a r).image stereo_chart_symm_continuous).isClosed
  have h_sub_cb : disk_at a r ⊆ stereo_chart.symm '' Metric.closedBall a r :=
    Set.image_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have h_clos_sub : closure (disk_at a r) ⊆ stereo_chart.symm '' Metric.closedBall a r :=
    closure_minimal h_sub_cb h_closed_cb
  intro z hz
  rw [frontier, h_open.interior_eq] at hz
  obtain ⟨w, hw_cb, rfl⟩ := h_clos_sub hz.1
  have hw_not_ball : w ∉ Metric.ball a r := fun hw_b => hz.2 ⟨w, hw_b, rfl⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hw_cb
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, not_lt] at hw_not_ball
  exact ⟨w, Metric.mem_sphere.mpr (le_antisymm hw_cb hw_not_ball), rfl⟩

lemma hofer_single_step (ϕ : ℂ → ℝ) (h_cont : Continuous ϕ) (h_nonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ ϕ y)
    (x : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hx_pos : 0 < ϕ x) :
    ∃ (a : ℂ) (lam R : ℝ),
      dist a x ≤ 2 * ε ∧
      0 < lam ∧ 0 < R ∧
      ε * ϕ x ≤ R ∧
      lam * ϕ a = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, dist z 0 ≤ R → lam * ϕ (a + lam • z) ≤ 2)

∀ (ϕ : Complex → Real),
  Continuous ϕ →
    (∀ (y : Complex), Real.instLE.le 0 (ϕ y)) →
      ∀ (x : Complex) (ε : Real),
        Real.instLT.lt 0 ε →
          Real.instLT.lt 0 (ϕ x) →
            Exists fun a =>
              Exists fun lam =>
                Exists fun R =>
                  And (Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist a x) (instHMul.hMul 2 ε))
                    (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 lam)
                      (And (Real.instLT.lt 0 R)
                        (And (Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul ε (ϕ x)) R)
                          (And (Eq (instHMul.hMul lam (ϕ a)) 1)
                            (∀ (z : Complex),
                              Real.instLE.le (NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing.dist z 0) R →
                                Real.instLE.le (instHMul.hMul lam (ϕ (instHAdd.hAdd a (instHSMul.hSMul lam z)))) 2)))))

  obtain ⟨ε', hε'_pos, x', _, hx'_dist, h_prod, h_bound⟩ :=
    _root_.hofer x ε hε h_cont h_nonneg
  have h_phi_x'_pos : 0 < ϕ x' := by
    have h_pos_prod : 0 < ε * ϕ x := mul_pos hε hx_pos
    have h_le : ε * ϕ x ≤ ε' * ϕ x' := h_prod
    have h_pos2 : 0 < ε' * ϕ x' := lt_of_lt_of_le h_pos_prod h_le
    by_contra h_neg
    push_neg at h_neg
    have h_mul_nonpos : ε' * ϕ x' ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hε'_pos.le h_neg
    linarith
  let M_val := ϕ x'
  let lam := 1 / M_val
  let R := ε' * M_val
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := one_div_pos.mpr h_phi_x'_pos
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := mul_pos hε'_pos h_phi_x'_pos
  have h_prod_eq : lam * R = ε' := by
    dsimp [lam, R, M_val]
    calc
      1 / ϕ x' * (ε' * ϕ x') = (1 / ϕ x' * ϕ x') * ε' := by ring
      _ = 1 * ε' := by rw [one_div_mul_cancel h_phi_x'_pos.ne']
      _ = ε' := by ring
  refine ⟨x', lam, R, hx'_dist, hlam_pos, hR_pos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [R]
    exact h_prod
  · dsimp [lam, M_val]
    exact one_div_mul_cancel h_phi_x'_pos.ne'
  · intro z hz
    have h_pos : 0 ≤ lam := hlam_pos.le
    have h_in : dist x' (x' + lam • z) ≤ ε' := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg h_pos]
      rw [dist_zero_right] at hz
      calc
        lam * ‖z‖ ≤ lam * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz h_pos
        _ = ε' := h_prod_eq
    have h_le := h_bound (x' + lam • z) h_in
    calc
      lam * ϕ (x' + lam • z) ≤ lam * (2 * M_val) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le h_pos
      _ = (lam * M_val) * 2 := by ring
      _ = 1 * 2 := by

        rw [one_div_mul_cancel h_phi_x'_pos.ne']
      _ = 2 := by ring

For $0 < r < R$, $\alpha \in (0, 1)$, and any $C^1$ map $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ on $\overline{D_R}$,
the $C^{0,\alpha}(D_r)$ norm of $f$ is controlled by the $C^0(D_R)$ norm of $\bar{\partial} f$ and $f$:

        C * (supNormOn (dbarComplex f) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) +
             supNormOn f (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R))

some sub-subsequence `cdata.σ.comp τ`, `extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv` holds with `0 unproved`.
signature:
theorem extract_grafted_tree_rescaling_and_conv_of_subseq_all_eq_root
    (u_seq : ℕ → (CP1 → M)) (B : ℝ) (th : Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
    (cdata : Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th)
    (m_defect : CP1 → ℝ)
    (P : PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S)
    (h_all : ∀ w : P.tree.V, w = P.root)
    (hS : cdata.S = ∅)
    (τ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap)
    (h_en_tendsto : Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).1 n))) atTop
      (𝓝 (totalEnergy I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, m_defect p))) :
    ∃ (σ : Bookkeeping.SubseqMap) (res : TreeRescalingData P.tree P.root),
      (∀ (frames : (v : P.tree.V) → ℕ → MoebiusFrame),
        (∀ n, frames P.root n = MoebiusFrame.id) →
        (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : w ≠ P.root) (n : ℕ),
          frames w n = MoebiusFrame.comp (frames (res.parent w hw) n)
            (affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) (res.scale_pos w n))) →
        ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
          SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
            (fun n => (u_seq (σ.1 n)) ∘ (frames v n).toHomeo)
            (P.map v)
            (punctured_sphere { z | ∃ (w : P.tree.V) (h : P.tree.adj.Adj v w), z = P.tree.node_point v w h })) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.1 n))) atTop
        (𝓝 (totalEnergy I cdata.u₀ + ∑ p ∈ cdata.S, m_defect p))
goal_type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace Real E] {H : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners Real E H) {M : Type u_3} [inst_3 : MetricSpace M]
  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]
  [inst_7 : GromovCompactness.ClosedTameTarget I M] (u_seq : Nat → GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → M) (B : Real)
  (th : GromovCompactness.Bubbling.TargetThresholds I M)
  (cdata : GromovCompactness.Compactness.ConcentrationData I u_seq B th) (m_defect : GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem → Real)
  (P : GromovCompactness.Assembly.PartialRootGraftedTree I u_seq B th cdata m_defect cdata.S),
  (∀ (w : P.tree.V), Eq w P.root) →
    Eq cdata.S Finset.instEmptyCollection.emptyCollection →
      ∀ (τ : GromovCompactness.Bookkeeping.SubseqMap),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).val n))) Filter.atTop
            (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))) →
          Exists fun σ =>
            Exists fun res =>
              And
                (∀ (frames : P.tree.V → Nat → GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame),
                  (∀ (n : Nat), Eq (frames P.root n) GromovCompactness.MoebiusFrame.id) →
                    (∀ (w : P.tree.V) (hw : Ne w P.root) (n : Nat),
                        Eq (frames w n)
                          ((frames (res.parent w hw) n).comp
                            (GromovCompactness.affine_scaling (res.center w n) (res.scale w n) ⋯))) →
                      ∀ (v : P.tree.V),
                        GromovCompactness.SmoothLocalConvergesOn I
                          (fun n => Function.comp (u_seq (σ.val n)) (EquivLike.toFunLike.coe (frames v n).toHomeo))
                          (P.map v)
                          (GromovCompactness.punctured_sphere
                            (Set.ofPred fun z => Exists fun w => Exists fun h => Eq z (P.tree.node_point v w h))))
                (Filter.Tendsto (fun n => GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I (u_seq (σ.val n))) Filter.atTop
                  (nhds (instHAdd.hAdd (GromovCompactness.totalEnergy I cdata.u₀) (cdata.S.sum fun p => m_defect p))))
proof:
by
  refine ⟨cdata.σ.comp τ, TreeRescalingData.of_all_eq_root P.tree P.root h_all, ?_, h_en_tendsto⟩
  intro frames h_root_id _ v
  have hv : v = P.root := h_all v
  subst hv
  have h_seq : (fun n => (u_seq ((cdata.σ.comp τ).1 n)) ∘ (frames P.root n).toHomeo) =
      fun n => (fun k => u_seq (cdata.σ.1 k)) (τ.1 n) := by
    ext n z
    rw [h_root_id n]
    rfl
  rw [h_seq, P.root_map]
  have h_conv_univ : SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => u_seq (cdata.σ.1 n)) cdata.u₀ Set.univ := by
    have h_diff : Set.univ \ (cdata.S : Set CP1) = Set.univ := by
      rw [hS, Finset.coe_empty, Set.diff_empty]
    simpa [h_diff] using cdata.smooth_conv
  have h_conv_sub : SmoothLocalConvergesOn I (fun n => (fun k => u_seq (cdata.σ.1 k)) (τ.1 n)) cdata.u₀ Set.univ :=
    smooth_local_subseq I (fun k => u_seq (cdata.σ.1 k)) cdata.u₀ Set.univ τ.2 h_conv_univ
  exact smooth_local_restriction I _ cdata.u₀ (Set.subset_univ _) h_conv_sub

    (v : { v : tree.V // v ≠ root }) (hv : v.1 ≠ w₀) :
    { z | ∃ (w : { v : tree.V // v ≠ root })
      (h : (prunedSimpleGraph tree root).Adj v w),

    have h1 : pdata.tree.node_point v.1 (origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root v w)

        pdata.tree.node_point v.1 w.1 hadj := by

    have h2 : pdata.tree.node_point w.1 (origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root w v)
        (origNeighbor_adj pdata.tree pdata.root w₁ w₂ hadj₁ hadj₂ w v
          ((suppressedSimpleGraph pdata.tree pdata.root w₁ w₂).adj_symm h)) =
        pdata.tree.node_point w.1 v.1 hadj_symm := by
      congr 1
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact pdata.nodal_match v.1 w.1 hadj
  · have hadj_symm : ¬ pdata.tree.adj.Adj w.1 v.1 := fun hs => hadj (pdata.tree.adj.adj_symm hs)
    have ho1 : origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root v w = pdata.root := if_neg hadj

    have hm2 := pdata.nodal_match w.1 (origNeighbor pdata.tree pdata.root w v)

    have hc_fn : ∀ (y : pdata.tree.V) (hy : y = pdata.root) (z : CP1), pdata.map y z = c := by
      intro y hy z; rw [hy]; exact hc z

    (h_weak : WeakMeasureConvergence (fun n => energyMeasureExtended I (u_seq (σ.1 n))) μ)

  [inst_4 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_5 : IsManifold I (WithTop.some instTopENat.top) M] [inst_6 : CompactSpace M]

  (S : Finset GromovCompactness.CP1.Elem),

  have hε₁_gt : m_r < ε₁ := by dsimp [ε₁]; linarith

    rw [← hm_r_eq]

signature:
theorem satisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder_const
    (k : ℕ) {α r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (c : ℂ) :
    SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R (fun _ => c)
goal_type:
∀ (k : Nat) {α r R : Real},
  Real.instLT.lt 0 r →
    Real.instLT.lt r R →
      Real.instLT.lt 0 α →
        Real.instLT.lt α 1 →
          ∀ (c : Complex), GromovCompactness.Analysis.SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder k α r R fun x => c
proof:
by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    unfold SatisfiesCauchyRiemannSchauder
    have hC₀ : 0 < cauchyPompeiuConstant r R α := cauchyPompeiuConstant_pos hr hrR hα0 hα1
    have hD : 0 ≤ ckHolderNorm 0 α (dbarComplex (fun _ => c)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) :=
      ckHolderNorm_nonneg 0 α _ _
    have hF : 0 ≤ supNormOn (fun _ => c) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) R) := supNormOn_nonneg _ _
    refine ⟨satisfiesCauchyPompeiuPointwise_const hr hrR hα0 hα1 c, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rintro y ⟨z, _hz, rfl⟩
      change ‖cauchyRiemann (fun _ => c) z‖ ≤ 0
      rw [cauchyRiemann_const c z, norm_zero]
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rintro q ⟨z, _hz, w, _hw, _hzw, rfl⟩
      change ‖cauchyRiemann (fun _ => c) z - cauchyRiemann (fun _ => c) w‖ / ‖z - w‖ ^ α ≤ 0
      rw [cauchyRiemann_const c z, cauchyRiemann_const c w, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_div]
    · intro z _hz
      have hf0 : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : ℂ => c) z 1 = 0 := by rw [fderiv_const_apply]; rfl

    have h_iter_zero : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fun _ : ℂ => c) =

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
